title: Medical Superintendent
description:
**Reporting To: Medical Director** 

**Overview:** Heading the medical services department and Clinical Operations to ensure that management of patient or services initial assessment to medical records as per the latest standards, to ensure for excellence and quality outcome. Manage medico\-legal and any other assessments in consultation Medical Director and CAO.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

1\. Develop and implement organizational policies and procedures for the medical unit.

2\. Government policies to be strictly adhered to \& to keep the hospital ready at all the time for government and internal audits and inspections.

3\. To coordinate (with respective departmental heads) and supervise Hospital infection control, nurses, strictly follow and implement NABH standards/policies.

4\. Maintain communication between governing bodies, medical staff and department heads by attending departmental meetings, and coordinating interdepartmental functioning.

5\. Monitor the functioning of pathology services, diagnostic services, facilities and staff to ensure the effective use of resources and assess the need for additional staff, equipment and services.

6\. Responsible for conducting clinical audits as per NABH/internal committee recommendation.

7\. Overseeing and monitoring RCA \& CAPA on all the audit findings and reporting the findings to the MD \& and the respective head promptly.

8\. Attend to Medical staff feedback and grievances. Counseling of nursing staff, para medical staff with the help of respective HOD’s, NS and HR.

9\. To ensure all the clinical operations adhere to relevant health laws with regards to medical compliances and to assure the prevention of Medico legal issues.

10\. Ensure the radiation safety compliance in all the applicable areas in coordination with the Radiation safety officer

11\. To make daily rounds and to see the completeness of clinical records including patient consent forms, assessment forms, Drug charts, Doctors \& Nurses progress notes.

12\. Ensure that consent forms are taken for all the clinical procedures.

13\. To supervise the lab in coordination with Lab Head and to assure that the lab reports are error free, Critical values are being reported to Wards/ICUs and the defined TATs are being strictly followed.

14\. Ensure seamless functioning of Operation theatre (OT) including utilization of OT, Scheduling of OT (in coordination with OT manager) \& identification of patient in OT ( Right patient , Right site and Right procedure )

15\. Meetings with Nursing Staff and other para\-medical staff to discuss measures for improvement of patient care and other related matters.

16\. Ensure the culture of patient safety in all patient care areas which includes deliverance of safe clinical practices, identification of patient \& avoidance of medication errors.

17\. Supervise the attendance of consultants/visiting consultants.

18\. Attending to medico\-legal cases as pertaining to Hospital, in coordination with the Medical Director and CAO.

19\. To supervise RMO’s Appointment, postings, compliance to their JDs, trainings, Doctors Handover notes etc.

20\. Ensuring the safe practices of blood transfusion in all patient care areas, that blood products given are safe to the right patient, right blood group and the right blood product.

21\. To ensure that all the statutory licenses of the hospital are valid.

22\. Ensure that the academic/training calendar is in place and academics are happening on regular basis.

23\. Ensure that the consultant rosters are in place and make sure that the consultants are being interacted on daily basis.

24\. To make daily rounds to patient care areas and make sure that all the required emergency support like Crash carts, Defibrillator are in place.

25\. To keep a track of complex/rare cases happening in the hospital and inform to MD \& CAO.

26\. If any clinical trials are being performed at the hospital, ensure the record compliance with the concerned department.

Pay: ₹96,316\.80 \- ₹180,000\.00 per month

 **Job Description**  

The Senior Program Manager will have multiple years of experience and plays a critical role in ensuring complex programs move forward with clarity, alignment, and operational discipline. This role drives structured execution by coordinating across multiple stakeholder groups, maintaining process integrity, facilitating reviews, enabling decision making, and ensuring program objectives are met on time and within scope.

 **Qualifications** **Program Oversight \& Daily Execution**

* Oversee day\-to\-day program activities, ensuring clear ownership, timelines, and deliverables.
* Review new program requests, charters, or change proposals for completeness and strategic fit.
* Coordinate across multiple workstreams, tracking progress and ensuring risks and dependencies are managed proactively.
* Maintain centralized tracking tools, dashboards, and status reports to provide clear visibility to leadership.

**Cross\-Functional Stakeholder Coordination**

* Partner closely with key functions including:  

	+ Product / Business – to align on goals, value, and prioritization.
	+ Operations \& PMO – to validate feasibility, capacity, and portfolio fit.
	+ Technology / Architecture – to assess technical implications and dependencies.
	+ Legal / Compliance / Risk – for regulatory or contractual reviews when required.
* Facilitate working sessions and review forums to keep stakeholders aligned and unblock issues.
* Escalate decisions or risks to leadership when cross\-functional alignment is required.

**Governance \& Process Management**

* Ensure programs follow established governance frameworks, stage gates, and approval steps.
* Maintain and continuously improve program documentation, templates, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Champion operational excellence by identifying and addressing process gaps and inefficiencies.
* Support strategic prioritization and portfolio alignment activities with leadership teams.

* Proactively identify program risks, interdependencies, and delivery challenges.
* Maintain structured RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) logs.
* Drive timely resolution through clear ownership, escalation, and tracking.
* Document and communicate key decisions to relevant stakeholders to ensure alignment and traceability.

**Training, Enablement \& Change Management:**

* Lead onboarding and enablement sessions for new stakeholders, ensuring clarity of processes and roles.
* Develop and maintain quick reference guides, training decks, and FAQs to support program execution.
* Communicate process updates, policy changes, or new tooling to all relevant teams.
* Act as a subject matter resource for best practices in program governance and execution.

**Reporting \& Metrics**

* Develop and maintain dashboards and status reports that track:  

	+ Program milestones and health
	+ Decision and review turnaround times
	+ Bottlenecks and throughput
	+ Resource utilization and capacity signals
* + Present program status, trends, and recommendations to leadership forums.
	+ Use data to drive continuous improvement and support strategic decision\-making.

* Opportunities for personal and professional growth.

**Our Benefits**

title: Claude AI Engineer- Trainee
description:
This Job Description is designed for a **Junior/Fresher AI Engineer** specializing in the emerging **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** ecosystem. Given that Claude Code and MCP represent a shift toward "agentic" development, this role focuses more on **orchestration, tool\-use design, and terminal\-based automation** than traditional full\-stack coding.

**Job Description: Junior AI Developer (MCP \& Agentic Systems)**Role Overview

We are looking for a motivated **Junior AI Developer** to join our team in building and scaling the next generation of autonomous agents. You will be at the forefront of the **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**, using **Claude Code** to develop servers that bridge the gap between Large Language Models (LLMs) and real\-world data/tools.

Key Responsibilities

* **Agent Development:** Design and implement MCP servers using Node.js or Python to provide Claude with custom "skills" (e.g., database access, API integrations, or local filesystem control).
* **Terminal\-First Workflow:** Use the **Claude Code CLI** as your primary development environment to refactor code, debug, and execute system\-level tasks.
* **Prompt Engineering:** Optimize system prompts and tool definitions to ensure high reliability and low "hallucination" rates in agentic loops.
* **Testing \& Validation:** Conduct rigorous testing of agentic workflows to ensure they handle edge cases and maintain security guardrails.
* **Documentation:** Maintain CLAUDE.md files and technical specs to ensure agents have the necessary context to remain productive across sessions.

Required Skills

* **Languages:** Proficiency in **TypeScript/Node.js** or **Python**.
* **Environment:** Strong comfort with the **Terminal (Linux/macOS)** and CLI\-based tools.
* **API Knowledge:** Understanding of RESTful APIs and JSON\-RPC.
* **AI Familiarity:** Basic understanding of LLM capabilities, specifically tool\-calling (function calling) and context window management.

**Fundamental Activities Every MCP Developer Must Know**

To be successful, a fresher should master these five core activities. These go beyond "writing code" and enter the realm of "teaching the AI how to use tools."

1\. Building an MCP Server (The "Bridge")

You must know how to wrap a standard API into an MCP server. This involves defining **Resources** (data the AI can read), **Tools** (actions the AI can take), and **Prompts** (templates the AI can follow).

* *Task:* Build a server that allows Claude to read a specific Google Sheet or local JSON database as a "Resource."

2\. Mastering the "Plan\-Action\-Verify" Loop

In Claude Code, you don't just "run" a script. You guide an agent.

* **Plan:** Use /plan to let Claude outline how it will solve a bug.
* **Action:** Monitor the terminal as Claude edits files and runs bash commands.
* **Verify:** Always run tests (e.g., npm test) via the agent to ensure the fix actually works.

3\. Context Management (CLAUDE.md)

Agents have a "memory" limit. A pro developer knows how to use a CLAUDE.md file in the root directory to store:

* Project\-specific coding standards.
* Common build commands.
* Architectural patterns.
* *Why?* This prevents the agent from asking the same questions every time you start a new session.

4\. Debugging via Agent Logs

When an agent fails, it’s usually because of a tool\-call error or a permission block.

* **Activity:** Read the JSON\-RPC logs between the MCP Client and Server.
* **Fix:** Adjust the tool definition if the AI is passing the wrong parameters (e.g., passing a string when the API expects an integer).

5\. Security \& Guardrails (The "Blast Radius")

Since agents can run terminal commands, you must learn to restrict them.

* **Activity:** Implementing **read\-only** vs. **read\-write** permissions for MCP servers.
* **Activity:** Running agents in containerized environments (like Docker) to prevent them from accidentally deleting your personal home directory.

**Work Days**

Monday to Saturday (6 days per week)

**Total Daily Hours**

**8 hours per day**

**Core Shift Time (IST)**

**Approximately 5:00 PM IST to 2:00 AM IST**

**US Time Overlap**

The core shift must overlap with **USA Eastern Standard Time (EST)** working hours, typically aligning from **5:00 PM IST to 1:00 AM IST**.

**Work Environment**

Fully Remote

**Collaboration Requirement**

Mandatory screen\-sharing connection and/or availability on call maintained throughout the full duration of the shift.

II. Initial Project Assessment

To formally start the engagement, all candidates will participate in an **Initial 10\-Day Project Assessment** that follows the same routine and work schedule outlined in Section I. The formal employment engagement will commence only upon successful completion and review of the performance during this 10\-day period.

III. Probation and Compensation StructureA. Probation Period

The initial employment period will be designated as a **Probationary Period** lasting between **Three (3\) to Four (4\) Months**. The exact duration will be determined by the hiring manager based on the initial assessment of the candidate's adaptation and contribution.

B. Compensation during Probation

During the entire Probationary Period, the compensation will be a fixed gross salary of **₹4,000** to **₹6,000 INR per month** ( based on skill level)

C. Post\-Probation Compensation (Performance\-Based)

Upon successful completion of the Probationary Period, the Developer’s monthly gross compensation will be raised to a range of **₹12,000 INR to ₹15,000 INR per month**.

The specific final compensation within this range will be determined based on a comprehensive performance review that assesses the following key factors:

* **Skills \& Technical Competence:** Demonstrated technical expertise and application of best practices.
* **Diligence \& Reliability:** Consistent work ethic, attendance, and adherence to processes.
* **Delivery Quality:** Quality, security, and maintainability of delivered code and features.
* **Overall Contribution:** Impact on project success and collaboration within the team.

IV. Collaborative Communication

The Developer is required to participate in two mandatory daily video/audio calls to ensure alignment and synchronization with the remote team structure, which overlaps with US working hours.

* **Daily Morning Call:** 8:00 AM IST
* **Daily Evening Call:** 5:30 PM IST

V. Professional Development \& Reimbursement

The Company supports continuous learning through professional certification.

* **Eligibility:** After successfully completing the Probationary Period.
* **Reimbursable Certifications:** Reimbursement will be considered for official certification exams from providers such as **Amazon Web Services (AWS)** and **Microsoft Azure**.
* **Condition:** Reimbursement is strictly conditional upon the certification having a **direct, demonstrable correlation** with current or upcoming development projects within the team. The reimbursement must be pre\-approved by the Lead Developer/CTO.

VI. Performance Improvement Clause (PIP)

The Company is committed to providing support to ensure consistent performance. However, a clear process is in place for addressing performance deficits.

* **Initial Feedback:** In the event of a noticeable dip in performance, the Developer will receive direct, constructive feedback and a performance plan within the first month of the dip being identified.
* **Failure to Improve:** If performance does not demonstrate adequate improvement following the initial feedback period, the Company reserves the right to implement a **reduction in monthly compensation**.
* **Pay Reduction Basis:** Any resulting reduction in pay will be proportional to the assessed **impact** the performance dip has on the project timelines, code quality, and team delivery capacity. This measure is intended to incentivize immediate course correction.

Pro Tip: A "Fresher" in this field is someone who stops thinking about code as a static file and starts thinking about code as a capability that an AI can exercise.

title: Senior Learning & Development Specialist
description:
**Why project44?**



At project44, **we believe in better.**



We challenge the status quo because we know a better supply chain isn’t just possible—it’s essential. Better for our customers. Better for their business. Better for the world.



With our **Decision Intelligence Platform,** ***Movement*****,** we’re redefining how global supply chains operate. By transforming fragmented logistics data into real\-time, AI\-powered insights, we empower companies to connect instantly, see clearly, act decisively, and automate intelligently. Our Supply Chain AI enhances visibility, drives smarter execution, and unlocks next\-gen applications that keep businesses moving forward.



Headquartered in Chicago, IL with a 2nd HQ in Bengaluru, India we are powered by a diverse global team that is tackling the toughest logistics challenges with innovation, urgency, and purpose.



If you’re driven to solve meaningful problems, leverage AI to scale rapidly, drive impact daily, and be part of a high\-performance team – we should talk.


**Role Overview**



We are seeking a Senior Learning \& Development (L\&D) Specialist who is resourceful, innovative, and AI\-driven to design, deliver, and optimize learning initiatives at project44\. This role blends instructional design expertise, technology\-driven learning solutions, and automation to scale impactful team member development across the globe. The ideal candidate has experience in instructional design, digital learning, program execution, and leveraging AI and data to modernize and enhance learning experiences.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Instructional Design \& Content Development**


* Design, develop, and maintain learning materials (eLearning, facilitator guides, microlearning, job aids, etc.) aligned with project44’s business goals.
* Apply instructional design frameworks (ADDIE, SAM, Bloom’s Taxonomy) to ensure learning effectiveness.


**AI \& Automation in L\&D**


* Leverage AI\-powered content creation tools (e.g., ChatGPT, MindSmith, Notebook LM) to accelerate development and improve learner engagement.
* Implement AI and automation tools to improve learning experiences (e.g., onboarding bots, adaptive learning paths, automated reporting).
* Stay updated on emerging AI applications in corporate learning and introduce innovative practices.
* Prototype and test AI\-enhanced simulations, virtual facilitators, and chatbots for onboarding and continuous learning.


**Program Management \& Delivery**


* Lead and manage end\-to\-end execution of global L\&D programs (onboarding, compliance, and functional upskilling).
* Coordinate with vendors, trainers, and internal subject\-matter experts (SMEs).
* Facilitate live and virtual learning sessions across multiple regions and time zones.
* Ensure learning solutions are accessible and available on\-demand.


**Stakeholder Collaboration**


* Partner cross\-functionally to identify skill gaps and design effective learning solutions.
* Champion a learning culture by promoting digital learning platforms and self\-directed growth.


**Qualifications \& Skills**


**Must\-Have**


* Bachelor’s degree in HR, Psychology, Education, Instructional Design, or related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in Learning \& Development, EdTech, or Instructional Design
* Proficiency in AI/automation tools for content creation, personalization, or workflow automation
* Strong knowledge of instructional design principles and adult learning theories.
* Proficiency with LMS platforms and eLearning authoring tools (Articulate, MindSmith, Seismic, or similar).
* Familiarity with learning data, analytics, and dashboards
* Excellent facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Highly resourceful, proactive, and detail\-oriented – experimental mindset and comfortable piloting new solutions.


**Good\-to\-Have**


* Master’s degree in HR, Psychology, Education, Instructional Design, or related field.
* Skills in video editing, graphic design, or multimedia content creation.
* Data analytics or dashboarding skills (Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or Google Data Studio).
* Experience integrating AI with learning platforms, HR systems, or productivity tools**.**
* Knowledge of xAPI, SCORM, or LRS (Learning Record Stores)**.**
* Exposure to multinational or SaaS companieswith fast\-paced, distributed workforces.
* Experience in internal/external branding, internal comms, content writing, or similar.


**In\-office Commitment:** This position requires a commitment to contribute to our collaborative culture by working **in\-office 5 days** weekly.


**Diversity \& Inclusion:**



At project44, we're designing the future of how the world moves and is connected through trade and global supply chains. As we work to deliver a truly world\-class product and experience, we are also intentionally building teams that reflect the unique communities we serve. We’re focused on creating a company where all team members can bring their authentic selves to work every day.



We’re building a company that every one of us at project44 is proud to work for, and our journey of becoming a more diverse, equitable and inclusive organization, where all have a sense of belonging, is shaped through the actions of our leadership, global teams and individual team members. We are resolute in our belief that each team member has an equal responsibility to mold and uphold our culture.



project44 is an equal opportunity employer seeking to enrich our work environment by creating opportunities for individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to thrive. If you share our values and our passion for helping the way the world moves, we’d love to review your application!



For any accommodation needed during the hiring process, please email recruiting@project44\.com. Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above job description you should still seriously consider applying. Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role’s requirements.


**More about project44:**



Since 2014, project44 has been transforming the way one of the largest, most important global industries does business. As transportation and logistics continue to evolve and customer expectations around delivery become more demanding, industry technology must rise to the occasion. In just a few short years, we have created a digital infrastructure that eliminates the inefficiencies caused by dated technology and manual processes. Our Advanced Visibility Platform is used by the world’s leading brands to track shipments, collaborate with supply chain partners, drive operational efficiencies, and create outstanding customer experiences.

title: Designer
description:
**Laser Sheet Cutting**

Laser sheet cutting is used to cut flat sheets of material, typically metal, into desired shapes and designs. The process involves directing a laser beam onto the sheet, which melts or vaporizes the material, creating a clean and precise cut. Laser sheet cutting is ideal for producing flat parts with intricate designs, such as signs, metal artwork, and electronic enclosures.

**Laser Tube Cutting**

Laser tube cutting is used to cut tubes and pipes, typically metal, into desired shapes and designs. The process involves rotating the tube while the laser beam cuts through it, creating complex shapes and angles. Laser tube cutting is ideal for producing structural components with complex geometries, such as furniture frames, automotive parts, and architectural elements.

**Fabrication**

Both laser sheet cutting and laser tube cutting can be integrated into fabrication processes to create complex assemblies and structures. For example, laser\-cut sheet metal parts can be bent and welded together to form enclosures or frames, while laser\-cut tubes can be joined to create trusses or supports.

**Advantages of Laser Cutting**

* **Precision and accuracy:** Laser cutting offers high precision and accuracy, allowing for intricate designs and tight tolerances.
* **Versatility:** Laser cutting can be used on a wide range of materials, including metals, plastics, and wood.
* **Speed:** Laser cutting is a fast process, especially for thin materials.
* **Clean cuts:** Laser cutting produces clean cuts with minimal burrs or edge defects.
* **Non\-contact process:** Laser cutting is a non\-contact process, which eliminates the need for cutting tools and reduces the risk of material damage.

**Applications**

Laser sheet cutting and laser tube cutting are used in a variety of industries, including:

* Automotive
* Aerospace
* Electronics
* Construction
* Furniture
* Medical devices
* Signage
* Metal fabrication

**Conclusion**

Laser sheet cutting and laser tube cutting are both powerful manufacturing processes that offer high precision, accuracy, and versatility. They are ideal for producing complex parts and assemblies in a variety of industries.

description:
**CARBONMAX ADVANTECH PVT LTD**

Indeed / Job Portal Posting \| Machine Operator \- Activated Carbon Manufacturing

**Machine Operator \- Granulation / Rotary Kiln / Post\-Activation Machines**

*Location: Carbonmax Factory, Ponnapuram Village, Dharapuram Taluk, Tirupur District, Tamil Nadu*

**Company**

Carbonmax Advantech Pvt Ltd

**Job Title**

Machine Operator \- Activated Carbon Manufacturing

**Machine Areas**

Granulation / Rotary Kiln Activation / Post\-Activation / Screening / Packing Support

**Department**

Production / Operations

**Work Location**

Factory at Ponnapuram Village, Dharapuram Taluk, Tirupur District, Tamil Nadu

**Employment Type**

Full\-time, factory\-based role; shift work applicable

**Experience**

Minimum 2 to 8 years preferred in process plant, kiln, furnace, dryer, crusher, screening, packing, chemical, mineral, foundry, boiler, cement, textile processing, or similar manufacturing operations. Fresh ITI / Diploma candidates with good attitude may also be considered for trainee operator roles.

**Qualification**

ITI / Diploma / 10th or 12th pass with relevant industrial machine operating experience

**Reporting To**

Shift In\-Charge / Production Supervisor / Production Manager

**Joining**

Immediate or early joiners preferred

About Carbonmax

Carbonmax Advantech Pvt Ltd is engaged in coconut shell based steam activated carbon manufacturing for domestic and export markets. The factory is located at Ponnapuram Village, Dharapuram Taluk, and is being developed with a strong focus on safe operations, disciplined production, quality consistency, cleanliness, training, and audit\-ready factory standards.

Job Summary

We are looking for disciplined and hardworking Machine Operators to operate and support production machinery used in coconut shell based steam activated carbon manufacturing. The role includes machine operation in granulation, rotary kiln activation, post\-activation processing, screening, packing support, material handling, basic machine cleaning, shift reporting, safety compliance, and maintaining production areas in clean and organized condition.

Key Responsibilities1\. Granulation / Crushing / Screening Operations

· Operate granulators, crushers, vibro screens, conveyors, bucket elevators, magnetic separators, dust collection systems, and related production equipment as instructed.

· Feed coconut shell charcoal / activated carbon material safely into machines as per production plan and supervisor instruction.

· Monitor product size, feed rate, material flow, screen condition, dust generation, abnormal sound, vibration, blockage, and machine performance during operation.

· Assist in changeover of mesh sizes, screens, bags, bins, hoppers, and related accessories as per grade requirement.

· Avoid material contamination, mix\-up, spillage, and unnecessary wastage during production.

2\. Rotary Kiln Activation Support

· Support operation of rotary kiln activation section under the instruction of Shift In\-Charge / Production Supervisor.

· Assist in feeding, kiln discharge monitoring, cooler operation, material movement, and safe handling of hot activated carbon as per SOP.

· Observe and report abnormal temperature, smoke, flame pattern, steam line issue, material choking, unusual sound, leakage, or unsafe condition immediately.

· Support routine cleaning around kiln, cooler, snout, discharge area, conveyors, and production floor to maintain safe and dust\-controlled operations.

· Strictly follow lockout, hot work, confined area, and equipment safety instructions whenever applicable.

3\. Post\-Activation Machine Operations

· Operate post\-activation machines such as destoner, screens, crushers, classifiers, elevators, conveyors, packing machines, and support equipment as assigned.

· Ensure activated carbon is processed as per grade, mesh size, customer requirement, and production instruction.

· Coordinate with QC / lab team for sample collection, batch identification, hold material, rejected material, and approved material movement.

· Maintain separation of different grades, batches, mesh sizes, and customer\-specific materials to prevent mix\-up.

· Support final screening, demagnetization, weighing, bagging, palletizing, and dispatch preparation when required.

4\. Production Discipline \& Shift Reporting

· Follow daily production plan and instructions given by Production Manager, Shift In\-Charge, or Department In\-Charge.

· Maintain basic machine log sheets including running hours, stoppage, breakdown, cleaning time, production quantity, rework, wastage, and observations.

· Report machine breakdowns, abnormal performance, quality issues, safety incidents, and material shortages immediately.

· Hand over the machine and production status properly to the next shift operator.

· Support supervisors in achieving production targets with quality, safety, and housekeeping discipline.

5\. Safety, Housekeeping \& 5S

· Wear required PPE such as safety shoes, helmet, gloves, mask / respirator, goggles, ear protection, and uniform as instructed.

· Maintain assigned machine area clean, dust\-controlled, organized, and audit\-ready at all times.

· Follow safety rules for rotating machines, hot material, dust, electrical panels, compressed air, conveyors, forklifts, and material handling equipment.

· Clean spillage immediately and keep pathways, emergency access, fire points, and electrical areas free from obstruction.

· Participate in toolbox talks, safety training, machine training, 5S activities, and continuous improvement practices.

6\. Maintenance Support

· Carry out basic machine cleaning, tightening observation, lubrication support, screen inspection, belt tracking observation, and minor routine checks as instructed.

· Inform maintenance team promptly about abnormal noise, belt slippage, bearing heating, loose parts, leakage, vibration, electrical issue, or mechanical damage.

· Assist maintenance team during shutdown, preventive maintenance, screen replacement, cleaning, trial run, and machine restart activities.

· Do not operate unsafe or defective equipment without supervisor clearance.

Required Skills \& Competencies

· Practical experience in operating industrial machinery in a manufacturing or process plant environment.

· Ability to follow SOPs, supervisor instructions, safety rules, and production discipline.

· Basic understanding of machine running condition, sound, vibration, heat, flow, choking, and maintenance warning signs.

· Willingness to work in shifts and in a rural factory environment.

· Good physical fitness for factory work, material handling support, standing, walking, cleaning, and machine monitoring.

· Ability to maintain cleanliness, avoid contamination, and work with quality consciousness.

· Teamwork, punctuality, honesty, discipline, and willingness to learn activated carbon manufacturing operations.

Preferred Candidate Profile

· Candidates from activated carbon, charcoal processing, chemical plant, cement, mineral processing, foundry, boiler, dryer, kiln, furnace, textile processing, food processing, or similar industries will be preferred.

· ITI Fitter / Electrician / Welder / Mechanical / Production trade candidates with machine operating experience are preferred.

· Candidates who can relocate or commute reliably to Ponnapuram Village / Dharapuram / nearby areas are preferred.

· Candidates with forklift, pallet trolley, basic maintenance, packing, weighing, or dispatch support experience will have an added advantage.

Education \& Experience

· **Education:** ITI / Diploma / 10th / 12th pass with relevant factory machine operating experience.

· **Experience:** 2 to 5 years preferred in machine operation. Freshers may be considered for trainee roles based on attitude and learning ability.

· **Language:** Tamil preferred. Basic Hindi / English understanding will be an added advantage.

· **Computer Knowledge:** Not mandatory. Basic ability to fill log sheets and production records is required.

Work Conditions

· Factory\-based role at Ponnapuram Village, Dharapuram Taluk.

· Shift duty and overtime may be applicable as per production requirement.

· Work involves dust\-prone process areas, rotating machinery, hot material zones, conveyors, screens, and material handling areas.

· Strict PPE, safety, hygiene, and housekeeping rules must be followed.

Why Join Carbonmax?

· Opportunity to work in a growing coconut shell based activated carbon manufacturing company.

· Hands\-on training in granulation, rotary kiln activation, post\-activation, screening, and packing operations.

· Professional factory culture focused on safety, cleanliness, discipline, quality, and continuous improvement.

· Long\-term career growth opportunity for sincere and hardworking operators.

Application Note for Job Portals

Interested candidates may apply with their updated resume, present salary, expected salary, notice period, current location, and details of machines previously operated. Candidates should be willing to work at Carbonmax factory located in Ponnapuram Village, Dharapuram Taluk, Tirupur District, Tamil Nadu.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

QA/QC Manager / Quality Head / Plant Head

Immediate or early joiners preferred

About Carbonmax

Carbonmax Advantech Pvt Ltd is engaged in coconut shell based steam activated carbon manufacturing for domestic and export markets. The factory is located at Ponnapuram Village, Dharapuram Taluk, and is being developed with a strong focus on quality systems, process discipline, laboratory testing, product consistency, safety, cleanliness, and audit\-ready operations.

Job Summary

We are looking for a sincere and technically strong Lab Chemist to support routine quality testing, process control testing, finished goods inspection, documentation, and laboratory discipline for coconut shell based steam activated carbon manufacturing. The candidate should be willing to work in a rural factory environment and support the QA/QC team with accurate testing, timely reporting, proper sample handling, and strict adherence to laboratory procedures.

Key Responsibilities1\. Laboratory Testing \& Analysis

· Carry out routine testing of coconut shell charcoal, in\-process activated carbon, finished activated carbon, and value\-added carbon samples.

· Perform testing for key activated carbon parameters such as iodine value, CTC activity, moisture, ash, pH, apparent density, hardness, particle size / mesh analysis, water soluble ash, acid soluble ash, and other required parameters as per internal SOPs.

· Support testing for acid washed, water washed, powdered, granular, and specialty activated carbon grades as required.

· Prepare reagents, standard solutions, indicators, and laboratory consumables as per approved methods.

· Ensure tests are completed accurately within the required turnaround time for production release and dispatch planning.

2\. Sampling \& Sample Management

· Collect and receive samples from raw material, activation, post\-activation, screening, packing, and dispatch areas as per sampling plan.

· Maintain proper sample identification, batch numbering, retention samples, and sample storage records.

· Coordinate with production, stores, packing, and dispatch teams for timely sample collection and result communication.

· Avoid sample mix\-up by following proper labelling, sealing, and documentation procedures.

3\. Quality Documentation \& Reporting

· Record test results accurately in laboratory registers, worksheets, ERP / Excel formats, and quality reports.

· Prepare daily test reports, batch\-wise quality reports, and internal quality summaries for review by the QA/QC Manager.

· Support preparation of Certificate of Analysis inputs and batch release data under the guidance of the Quality Head.

· Maintain calibration records, reagent preparation records, equipment usage logs, sample registers, and housekeeping checklists.

· Immediately report any abnormal result, deviation, repeat test, or out\-of\-specification observation to the QA/QC Manager.

4\. Laboratory Equipment \& Calibration

· Operate and maintain laboratory equipment such as ovens, muffle furnace, pH meter, weighing balance, mechanical sieve shaker, hardness tester, glassware, titration setup, and other testing instruments.

· Perform routine verification and basic calibration checks as per laboratory schedule.

· Ensure instruments are clean, labelled, maintained, and used only as per SOP.

· Report instrument breakdowns, abnormal readings, and maintenance requirements promptly.

5\. Factory Quality Support

· Support production quality monitoring during granulation, activation, cooling, destoning, crushing, screening, post\-activation, packing, and dispatch stages.

· Help identify variation in raw charcoal quality, activation output, particle size distribution, hardness, ash, and other quality parameters.

· Support corrective actions and re\-testing when quality deviation is observed.

· Coordinate with shift in\-charges and department teams to ensure samples are tested and communicated without delay.

6\. Safety, Cleanliness \& Laboratory Discipline

· Follow laboratory safety rules while handling acids, alkalis, chemicals, hot equipment, glassware, and sample materials.

· Maintain the laboratory in clean, organized, audit\-ready condition at all times.

· Use PPE such as lab coat, gloves, goggles, safety shoes, and mask wherever required.

· Ensure proper chemical storage, labelling, disposal, and segregation of laboratory waste.

· Follow 5S, housekeeping, and safety discipline expected in a professional manufacturing factory.

Required Skills \& Competencies

· Good practical knowledge of wet chemistry, titration, weighing, sample preparation, and analytical calculations.

· Ability to follow SOPs and standard test methods with discipline and repeatability.

· Basic knowledge of laboratory safety, chemical handling, and documentation practices.

· Good numerical ability, observation skills, and attention to detail.

· Basic computer knowledge including MS Excel, data entry, report preparation, and email communication.

· Ability to work with production and QA/QC teams in a factory environment.

· High integrity in reporting results without manipulation or shortcuts.

· Willingness to work in Ponnapuram Village / Dharapuram factory location.

Preferred Industry Background

· Activated carbon / carbon products / charcoal processing industry.

· Chemical manufacturing or process industry laboratory.

· Water treatment chemicals, minerals, food ingredients, pharma, cement, textile processing, or environmental laboratory.

· Experience in ISO\-based documentation, quality systems, and customer audit support will be an added advantage.

What We Expect from the Candidate

title: Junior Full-Stack Developer - Arthace (Surat, Onsite)
description:
**About Arthace** Arthace ("Maximise Financial Intelligence") is an AI\-powered double\-entry accounting product for Indian businesses. We're at pilot stage and shipping toward a public launch in couple of months. We're hiring our first engineer to take over day\-to\-day engineering execution and ship the launch alongside the founder.

**Role at a glance**

* Position: Junior Full\-Stack Developer (first technical hire)
* Experience: 1–3 years (strong freshers with shipped projects also welcome)
* Salary: ₹25,000 – ₹35,000 per month (top of band for clear AI\-tool shipping history)
* Hours: Mon–Sat, standard business hours, onsite
* Reporting: Directly to founders
* **Immediate joiners strongly preferred**

**Where you'll work**

* **First month:** at our office in Tatithaiya (Block 178, Parekh Industrial Estate, Tal\-Palsana, Surat 394315\), working closely with the engineering founder
* **From month 2 onward:** at our coworking space in **Vesu, Surat** with the rest of the team

This is an onsite role.

**What you'll own**

*Bug fixing in the live product*

* Take partner\-reported bugs across voucher pages, reports, and master data screens; locate the surface in our React \+ Node \+ Postgres codebase; ship a clean fix using AI coding tools
* Read AI\-generated code critically \- catch issues, push back when something is wrong, validate the output before it ships
* For accounting\-sensitive changes, run the audit checks before pushing \- incorrect numbers are unacceptable

*Deploys and CI*

* Own the deploy pipeline on Railway: every push triggers a deploy, you confirm the healthcheck goes green and surface failed builds with the failing log step
* Own GitHub Actions CI hygiene: when tests go red, you triage whether it's a real regression or an environment issue, and resolve it the same day
* Manage environment variables and connection strings carefully \- no credentials in chat, ever

*Data safety*

* Own daily Postgres backups, restore tests, and off\-site copies. Client financial data must never be lost
* Maintain SSL, secrets management, access control, and a sensible security posture we can show clients

*Release handoffs to QA*

* After every shipped change, author a clear "for smoke test" handoff document
* Co\-founder Rahul runs partner\-pilot QA on every release before it goes live; you collate his retest feedback at the start of the next session and flag what passed vs. what still needs work

*Pilot growth*

* Help onboard new pilot accountants: run our import scripts, verify the trial balance matches their existing system
* As you ramp, take ownership of one larger feature track post\-launch (bank reconciliation / GSTR\-2A / multi\-tenant scale\-up)

**Must\-have skills**

* Hands\-on experience using **AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) to actually build and ship a project** \- please share what you built
* Working knowledge of **Node.js or Python** \- comfortable reading and writing backend code
* Comfort with **Git, command line, and reading logs** (build logs, server logs, browser console errors)
* Experience **deploying an application to a real server** (Railway, Vercel, AWS, DigitalOcean, Hetzner, or similar) \- env vars, healthchecks, connection strings
* Basic **SQL** — SELECT / JOIN / WHERE / GROUP BY, transactions, indexes
* Strong written and spoken English \- you'll write daily release handoffs another person executes without re\-asking
* Honesty about what you do and don't know

**Nice to have**

* PostgreSQL or Prisma ORM beyond basic queries
* React / JSX comfort (controlled inputs, useState, useEffect)
* Familiarity with Indian accounting (GST, TDS, Trial Balance, vouchers) or accounting software (Tally, Zoho Books, QuickBooks)
* Conversational Hindi \- useful for nuanced bug reports from pilot partners
* Side projects on GitHub

**Who you are**

* Owner, not ticket\-closer. If something is broken before a client demo, you tell us before we find out
* Careful with data. Accounting numbers must be exactly right
* Pattern\-spotter. When a bug shows up in one place, your first instinct is to check whether the same pattern exists elsewhere in the code
* Process\-oriented. You document what you ship and what you tested
* Want to grow into a senior role as we scale

**Why this role is interesting**

* First engineering hire on a paying\-pilot accounting product, going to launch this year
* Direct working relationship with the founders, no manager layer
* Deep, real\-world exposure to AI\-paired software development
* Clear path to Senior Engineer / Tech Lead as we incorporate and scale
* Compensation moves with performance and the company's stage

**How to apply** Apply through Indeed with:

* A short cover note (5–10 lines): what you've shipped using AI coding tools. Link, demo, or GitHub repo ideal
* CV / resume
* Current notice period and earliest joining date
* Expected monthly salary

Email: **hello@rahuldbhatia.com**. WhatsApp **\+91 98252 75100** for quick questions only \- not for applications.

Arthace is an equal\-opportunity employer. We hire based on what you can build, not where you went to school.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

* Have you used Claude, Cursor, Copilot, or similar AI coding tools to build and ship a project? (Yes / No)
* Briefly describe one project you built using AI coding tools.
* Do you have at least 1 year of hands\-on experience with Node.js or Python? (Yes / No)
* Have you deployed an application to a production server? (Yes / No, name the platform)
* Are you willing to work onsite in Surat — first month at Tatithaiya, then Vesu coworking? (Yes / No)

We are looking for a skilled HR manager to oversee all aspects of Human Resources practices and processes. * Maintains the work structure by updating job requirements and job descriptions for all positions.
* Supports organization staff by establishing and interviewing program; counselling managers on candidate selection; conducting and analyzing exit interviews; and recommending changes.
* Prepares employees for assignments by establishing and conducting orientation and training programs.
* Manages a pay plan by conducting periodic pay surveys; scheduling and conducting job evaluations; preparing pay budgets; monitoring and scheduling individual pay actions; and recommending, planning, and implementing pay structure revisions.

 Cityfurnish is a fast\-growing furniture and appliance rental platform operating across 7 Indian cities. We combine technology, design, and operations to deliver a seamless subscription experience — and we're now building the people infrastructure to match our growth.

 We're looking for a Senior HR Manager to own the entire people function — from hiring and compliance to administration and legal. title: Associate Financial Analyst
description:
**Financial Analyst**

**This Position**  combines deep expertise in financial statement analysis and Excel\-based modelling with the ability to communicate complex insights clearly — both in written reports and live presentations. You will play a critical role in guiding data\-driven decisions across business units and senior leadership.

**Key Responsibilities** 

* Analyse financial statements — income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements — for business units, clients, and investment opportunities.
* Perform ratio analysis (liquidity, profitability, leverage, efficiency) to evaluate financial health and performance trends.
* Build, maintain, and enhance dynamic financial models and dashboards in Excel for forecasting, variance analysis, and scenario planning.
* Prepare polished, professional presentations (PowerPoint/slides) to communicate findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Prepare clear, concise written reports summarising financial insights, risks, and strategic recommendations.
* Support budgeting, planning, and month\-end/quarter\-end close processes with accurate financial data.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (operations, risk, legal, sales) to provide financial insights that inform decisions.
* Monitor KPIs and flag variances or anomalies for management review.
* Ensure all financial analysis and documentation comply with company policies and applicable regulatory standards.
* Stay informed on market developments, industry benchmarks, and macroeconomic trends relevant to the business.

**Financial Analysis \& Modelling**

* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel — data entry, basic formulas (SUM, AVERAGE, IF), and simple charts for reporting purposes.
* Ability to organise and maintain financial data in structured spreadsheets for day\-to\-day analysis tasks.
* Financial statement analysis — reading and interpreting income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements.
* Comprehensive ratio analysis — liquidity (current, quick), profitability (ROE, ROA, EBITDA margins), solvency (D/E, interest coverage), and efficiency (asset turnover, receivables days).
* Cash flow analysis — operating vs. investing vs. financing activities; free cash flow computation and interpretation.

Soft Skills:

* Exceptional written communication — ability to draft clear, structured financial reports and executive summaries.
* Strong verbal communication — comfortable presenting analysis and recommendations to senior management and non\-finance stakeholders.
* Advanced presentation skills — translates complex data into compelling visual narratives, experience with slide storytelling.
* Active listening and stakeholder management — understands business context and tailors’ communication accordingly.
* Strong analytical and critical thinking with meticulous attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver under deadlines.
* Collaborative mindset with a proactive, solution\-oriented attitude.

title: Polymer Laboratory Technician
description:
Working at **Ray Colors**, a specialized masterbatch manufacturer based in Anand, Gujarat, involves working with high\-tech equipment to develop and test colorants and performance additives. Since they cater to demanding sectors like fiber, automotive, and packaging, the role of a Lab Technician is critical for maintaining their reputation for "innovation and honesty."

Below is a structured job description tailored for both entry\-level and experienced candidates.

Job Title: Polymer Lab Technician

**Location:** Anand (Vitthal Udyognagar), Gujarat

**Company:** Ray Colors (Masterbatch \& Compound Division)

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

Role Overview

You will be responsible for the formulation, testing, and quality assurance of polymer masterbatches. This includes color matching, physical property testing, and operating lab\-scale machinery to ensure products meet stringent industrial standards (ISO/ASTM).

Key ResponsibilitiesFor Freshers (Trainee Level)

* **Sample Preparation:** Assist in weighing pigments, additives, and resins according to batch cards.
* **Machine Operation:** Learn to operate lab\-scale extruders, injection molding machines, and blown\-film lines under supervision.
* **Testing Basics:** Perform routine tests such as **Melt Flow Index (MFI)** and moisture analysis.
* **Housekeeping:** Maintain a clean and organized laboratory environment and ensure all samples are labeled and stored correctly.
* **Documentation:** Accurately record test data in lab registers or ERP systems.

For Experienced Candidates (Senior/Technician Level)

* **Color Matching:** Use spectrophotometers to match precise shades and develop new color formulations (Black, White, and Special Effects).
* **Advanced Testing:** Conduct complex analyses including **Filter Pressure Tests (FPT)**, Tensile Strength, and UV Weathering tests.
* **R\&D Support:** Collaborate with the R\&D team to develop "Nano Masterbatches" or high\-performance additives.
* **Troubleshooting:** Identify the root cause of batch failures (e.g., poor dispersion or pigment streaks) and suggest corrective actions.
* **Calibration:** Manage the periodic calibration and maintenance of sensitive lab instruments.

Technical Skills \& Qualifications

* **Education:** B.Sc./M.Sc. in Chemistry, Diploma/B.E. in Polymer Technology, or a PGD\-PPT from **CIPET**.
* **Knowledge:** Understanding of carrier polymers (PE, PP, PET, ABS, etc.) and the chemistry of pigments/additives.
* **Standards:** Familiarity with ASTM/ISO testing standards for plastics.
* **Software:** Basic proficiency in MS Office (Excel) for data reporting.

Required Competencies

* **Attention to Detail:** Critical for accurate color matching where even a $0\.1\\%$ variance matters.
* **Safety Mindset:** Strict adherence to PPE protocols (gloves, masks, goggles) when handling chemicals and hot machinery.
* **Analytical Thinking:** Ability to interpret data and translate it into process improvements.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹14,000\.00 per month

We are setting up a \*\*robotics\-integrated pipe processing factory\*\* focused on fire protection systems (cutting, grooving, hole\-making, etc.).

\* Take complete \*\*handover from the technical consultant\*\*

\* Run \*\*day\-to\-day factory operations\*\*

\* Ensure \*\*machines, robotics, and manpower\*\* are aligned to production goals

You will be fully responsible for \*\*operational efficiency, production output, and factory discipline\*\*.

**\*\*Key Responsibilities\*\***

**1\. Factory Operations Management**

\* Oversee complete factory operations including:

\* Pipe processing (cutting, hole making, grooving)

\* Material movement and workflow

\* Ensure \*\*daily production targets (in meters/pipes)\*\* are achieved

\* Maintain \*\*process discipline and workflow efficiency\*\*

**2\. Robotics \& Machine Handling**

\* Learn and operate \*\*robotic systems (Delta robots / automation lines)\*\*

\* Take \*\*complete technical handover\*\* from third\-party consultant

\* Monitor machine performance and troubleshoot basic issues

\* Coordinate with vendors/consultants for advanced technical issues

**\*\*Important: \*\* Robotics experience is \*not mandatory\*, but strong \*\*technical learning ability is compulsory\*\***

**3\. Team \& Labour Management**

\* Manage shop\-floor labour and operators

\* Allocate daily tasks and monitor productivity

\* Ensure discipline, attendance, and work quality

\* Train workers as per SOPs

**4\. Production Planning \& Execution**

\* Execute production based on:

\* Project requirements

\* Dispatch timelines

\* Optimize machine utilization and reduce idle time

\* Coordinate between \*\*design, production, and dispatch teams\*\*

**5\. SOP Implementation \& Process Control**

\* Follow and implement SOPs provided by technical consultant

\* Standardize operations for:

\* Quality

\* Safety

\* Efficiency

title: Sr. Accountant
description:
**About Om Electricals Power Pvt. Ltd.**

Since 1978, OEPL has set the benchmark for HT \& LT motor, transformer, and electromagnet rewind, repair, and reconditioning across eastern India. Our world\-class workshop infrastructure and four decades of expertise empower us to deliver precision, reliability, and safety on every project.

**Role Overview**

We’re seeking an experienced and detail\-oriented **Accountant** to manage the financial health and daily accounting operations of our company. You will drive financial reporting, tax compliance, cost accounting, and cash flow management to ensure the fiscal efficiency and profitability of our heavy\-engineering and workshop services.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Financial Accounting \& Bookkeeping**
* Maintain precise daily records of all financial transactions using accounting software.
* Manage Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR), ensuring timely payments to raw material vendors (e.g., copper, insulation suppliers) and prompt invoicing for completed workshop projects.
* **Cost Accounting \& Inventory Management**
* Implement and oversee job\-costing methods to track the exact costs associated with individual motor rewind and transformer overhaul projects.
* Monitor and reconcile inventory valuations for raw materials, workshop tools, and work\-in\-progress to optimize budget utilization.
* **Taxation \& Statutory Compliance**
* Calculate, prepare, and file monthly/quarterly statutory returns, including GST, TDS, PF, and ESI.
* Ensure strict adherence to Indian Accounting Standards and local financial regulations.
* **Reporting \& Reconciliation**
* Perform regular bank, vendor, and ledger reconciliations.
* Prepare comprehensive financial statements (Profit \& Loss, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) and monthly MIS reports for senior management to track workshop profitability.
* **Audit \& Financial Planning**
* Coordinate with internal and external auditors, ensuring all financial documentation and ledgers are accurate and readily available.
* Assist management in preparing annual budgets, forecasting financial needs, and implementing cost\-control measures across workshop operations.

**Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Commerce (B.Com/M.Com) or Finance. Candidates with CA Inter or CMA (ICWA) Inter qualifications are highly preferred.
* **Experience:**
* 4–7 years of proven accounting experience.
* **Technical Proficiency:**
* Expertise in **Tally Prime**.
* Deep understanding of current GST structures, TDS, and corporate taxation rules.
* Familiarity with ERP systems is a strong advantage.
* **Leadership \& Soft Skills:**
* Meticulous attention to detail, high integrity, and strong analytical problem\-solving abilities.
* Clear communicator in English and Hindi; capable of liaising effectively with procurement teams, workshop managers, and external vendors.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary with performance\-based bonuses.
* The stability of working for a heritage company that partners with landmark clients (NTPC, Coal India, DVC, Bokaro Steel).
* Professional development and opportunities to streamline financial operations.
* A collaborative and supportive corporate office environment attached to modern workshop facilities.

title: HR Interns
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and proactive HR Intern with a strong interest in Indian Labour Law and Compliance Implementation. In this role, you will help bridge the gap between statutory requirements and daily HR operations. You will support the HR department in auditing existing practices, drafting compliant policies, and ensuring our organization adheres to the latest Central and State\-specific labor regulations in India.
   

  

 This is an ideal opportunity for a student or recent graduate pursuing an MBA in HR, a Master’s in Labour Studies (MLS), or a Bachelor of Laws (LLB) to gain hands\-on experience in a corporate compliance environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Statutory Research \& Monitoring


 Conduct research on the four new Labour Codes (Wage, Social Security, Industrial Relations, and Occupational Safety) and their phased implementation.
   

  

 Track updates regarding state\-specific Shops and Establishments Acts and Professional Tax requirements.
   

  

 Assist in mapping Central and State\-specific compliance requirements to internal HR processes.
   

  

* Policy Drafting \& Indian Compliance


 Assist in updating the Employee Handbook to ensure compliance with the Standing Orders Act and local leave policies.
   

  

 Support the POSH (Prevention of Sexual Harassment) Committee with administrative tasks, awareness posters, and documentation of training sessions.
   

  

 Draft Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for grievance redressal as per the Industrial Disputes Act.
   

  

* Compliance Auditing \& Payroll Support


 Perform audits of employee files to ensure mandatory documentation (Aadhaar, UAN, PAN, nomination forms) is complete.
   

  

 Review job descriptions to ensure alignment with Code on Wages definitions (e.g., distinguishing between 'Worker' and 'Employee' categories).
   

  

 Assist with "Statutory Health Checks" including EPF, ESI, and Gratuity record\-keeping.
   

  

* Training \& Education


 Help design internal training materials for managers on the POSH Act and the Maternity Benefit Act.
   

  

 Prepare FAQs on Indian tax deductions (TDS) and social security benefits to help employees understand their pay slips.
   

  

* Employee Relations \& Onboarding


 Support the HR team in drafting offer letters and employment contracts that comply with the latest Indian judicial precedents.
   

  

 Ensure all exit formalities align with statutory requirements for full and final (F\&F) settlements.
   

  

**Requirements \& Qualifications**
 Education: Currently pursuing or recently completed an MBA (HR), Master of Labour Studies (MLS), or LLB.
   

  

 Legal Literacy: Foundational knowledge of Indian Labour Laws (e.g., Factories Act, EPF Act, ESI Act, POSH Act, and Payment of Bonus Act).
   

  

 Attention to Detail: High level of precision in reviewing statutory registers and employee records.
   

  

 Confidentiality: Absolute discretion in handling sensitive employee data and PII (Personally Identifiable Information).
   

  

 Communication: Strong writing skills in English; proficiency in Hindi or other regional languages is an added advantage for interpreting local state rules.
   

  

 Learning Objectives
   

  

 By the end of this internship, the candidate will have:
   

  

 Developed a practical understanding of how Indian Labour Laws translate into corporate policy.
   

  

 Gained experience in risk mitigation, statutory filing processes, and HR auditing.
   

  

 Built a portfolio of drafted policies and compliance communication materials.
   

  

 Learned the complexities of managing compliance across different Indian states.

title: Cluster Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
With thousands of hotels in over 100 countries and territories, Hilton offers countless opportunities to delight. From an open door to a welcoming smile and an exceptional experience, we offer the millions of travellers who stay with us every year a welcome they will never forget. In addition to our flagship brand, Hilton Hotels \& Resorts, the family of brands includes Waldorf Astoria, LXR, Conrad, Canopy, Curio Collection, DoubleTree, Hilton Garden Inn, Hampton and many others.
   

  

 If you appreciate the impact global travel can have on the world, you may be just the person we are looking for to work as a Hilton Team Member. Because it’s with Hilton where we never forget the reason we're here: to delight our guests, Team Members, and owners alike.
   

  

**The Cluster Talent Acquisition Manager is responsible for leading the end\-to\-end recruitment function for five hotels i.e., Hilton and Hilton Garden Inn Bengaluru Embassy Manyata Business Park, Hilton Bangalore Embassy Golf Links, Hilton and Hilton Garden Inn Bangalore Embassy Tech Village, aligning recruitment activities with business goals, and ensuring a consistent, high\-quality talent pipeline. This role requires strong strategic planning, operational excellence, and a passion for building Hilton’s reputation as an employer of choice.**
**What will I be doing?**
 As the Cluster Talent Acquisition Manager, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:
   

  

* Responsible for managing the entire recruitment process (end\-to\-end) for all five hotels in the cluster.
* Report directly to the Cluster Director of Human Resources (Cluster DHR).
* Assist with the annual hotel manning budget by participating in headcount planning discussions with department heads.
* Develop and implement the annual cluster recruitment strategy to ensure timely hiring of qualified candidates.
* Maintain and expand effective recruitment channels and execute strategic recruitment activities.
* Ensure all open positions are posted on relevant recruitment platforms with brand\-compliant job advertisements.
* Source candidates, conduct first\-round interviews for all positions below Director level, and coordinate with hiring managers for subsequent interviews.
* Participate in campus hiring drives, job fairs, and recruitment campaigns across schools, colleges, and universities.
* Establish and maintain a systematic database of candidate profiles and recruitment activities.
* Monitor recruitment effectiveness and market trends, providing insights and strategy updates to HR leadership.
* Ensure timely candidate communication, feedback, onboarding, and smooth check\-in processes.
* Maintain professionalism and protect the Hilton employer brand across all recruitment touchpoints.

**About The Health Insurance Industry –**
 While the current market sees more than 15 non\-life players in the private space and 5 exclusive private players in the health insurance space trying to capture a sizable market share, the nationalised service provider (6\) remains a strong competitor. In addition to this the business dynamics are such that the overall market on an annual basis which is to the tune of roughly 10,000 Crs sees close to 85 % of the business renewing with the existing service provider itself. This narrows down the opportunity of the fresh business actually being seriously fought in the market to approximately 1500 odd Crs. With the SME and the start\-ups being the driving force of Indian economy, the opportunity to cater to these segments is immense and is increasing manifold year on year. The challenge here therefore remains as to how we capture a larger share of the opportunity by developing specific solutions to cater each segment of the business. Also by creating an inexpensive and standardized solution to increase the reach into the pockets of channel partners across the country to harness on their captive business and explore new opportunities with them.
   

  

 Market Opportunities – With the advent of medical advancements, lifestyle changes, change in Indian socio\-economic scenario and Indian healthcare space, and the insurers are facing challenges to cater to the needs of this diverse clientele. Increasingly Indian customers have started considering health insurance partners as intentions of health advisers. In this scenario it becomes extremely important to understand their psyche and then provide tailored solutions with wellness benefits which would help them meet their end objectives and bring in profitable revenue source for the company.
   

  

**About The Aditya Birla Health Insurance –**
 Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited (ABHICL) was incorporated in 2015 as a 51:49 joint venture between Aditya Birla Capital Limited (ABCL) and MMI Strategic Investments (Pty) Ltd. ABHICL commenced its operations in October 2016\.
   

  

 ABHICL has entered the competitive health insurance market with an aim to expand the category to wider customer segments, beyond the ones that health insurance companies traditionally have marketed to. As the 6 th entrant in a category with well\-established players, ABHICL is creating differentiation and equity for itself though the unique business proposition of “Health Insurance for All”, a one of a kind proposition in India at the moment. This is a philosophy that is being built through every single consumer touch point and into every single backend process of the company to ensure a customer’s experience of our proposition is continuous and seamless.
   

  

 ABHI’s unique offering to market includes proposition includes \-
   

  

* A Comprehensive Incentivized Wellness Program that will attract the young and health conscious and will motivate, guide and reward them to stay healthy
* A Chronic Care Management Program to cater to the unmet needs of a growing Indian population of those suffering from chronic lifestyle conditions like Diabetes, Asthma, High Cholesterol and Hypertension from Day 1
* ABHICL serves as an enabler and influencer of health and healthcare choices that customers make, in addition to being a payer of healthcare expenses. Thus, ABHICL would act like a much needed catalyst to grow the prevalent health insurance landscape in India through product innovations and a wider choice of consumer relevant products.
* ABHICL’s vision has always been digital. The company has been successful in adopting paper\-less approach right from identifying to on\-boarding to delivering seamless experience of its customers \& employees.


**Challenges –**
* Though there is a strong association in employees – most of them have running policies from other companies and do not want to port immediately
* The road to customers is often through significant seniors in ABG, who need to understand inherent value proposition before granting access to other employees of organisation
* Since the customers are group employees and their references – any lacunae in service leads to immediate escalations.
* Soft Insurance Market: Considering the soft insurance market in India, offering new\-age solutions to price sensitive clients is difficult. It is extremely important to design and customize the right solution for the right set of clients.
* Upskill the recruited workforce and enable them to do concept selling as against hitherto habit of price based selling.
* Initiatives launched across companies need approvals from Heads in other companies – it is often difficult to secure their time to explain the product offerings and take their approvals to conduct activities.
* The customers often expect customised offerings. Offering and structuring a deal often involves working with various departments like operations, claims, actuarial etc to see what best can be offered. There may be instances that actuarial may not be comfortable offering a particular price that has been made available to the customer and hence working with them to see how best can things be modulated is often a tough ask. Also getting various stakeholders and constituents to the process like operations to understand the sensitivities of the various partners involved and seeing the creation of a process which meets our objective without offending either the partner concerned or the internal norms gets to be a challenge that has to be fought on a daily basis.

**About Olio** 




 Olio Global AdTech LLP is
 **a growth marketing and technology transformation agency** 
 having its offices in Mumbai \& Pune. We're a 25\-person team across Strategy, Technology, SEO, Performance Marketing, Content, Creative, UI UX.
 



  





**This is a foundational hire.** 
 You'll be Olio's dedicated hiring, people operations \& culture leader, reporting directly to the Founders, with a meaningful seat in shaping how Olio scales over the next 18\-24 months. 
 



  





**Why This Role Is Different** 




 Most HR roles are either pure recruitment or pure operations — But here you'll wear three hats and become Olio's HRM operational backbone.
 



  





**Pillar 1 — Talent Acquisition (35%):** 




 Own the full hiring lifecycle for 15\-20 hires across the year. JD creation, sourcing, screening, scheduling, offer rollout, joining. You'll close most junior/mid hires yourself; partner with founders on senior hires.
 



  





**Pillar 2 — People Operations \& Employer Branding (40%):** 




 Own onboarding, employee handbook, POSH compliance, performance reviews, engagement, exits — and equally important, build Olio's employer brand. We want innovative ideas and execution that make Olio one of the most desirable agencies to work at in India.
 



  





**Pillar 3 — Operations \& Founder's Office (25%):** 




 Run office administration across both Mumbai HQ and Pune Baner, coordinate founder calendars and travel, manage vendors and finance liaison with accounts, own internal programs (Training, L\&D), drive internal communications, and become the operational glue between the core team and the rest of the team.
 



  





**Who You Are** 




**Experience:** 
 0\-3 years in HR, Talent Acquisition, or HR \+ Admin/Operations roles. Currently at HR Executive / Sr. HR Executive / TA Specialist / HR \& Admin Manager level.
 



  





**Background (Preference):** 
 You've worked in\-house at a marketing, advertising, digital, or creative agency. Bonus if you've already worn both HR and Operations hats.
 



  





**Track record (Preference):** 
 You've personally closed 10\+ hires, you've been involved in onboarding/ policies/ engagement, and ideally you've also driven employer branding initiatives or owned operational/admin work.
 



  





**Mindset:** 
 You're hungry. You want to own something, not coordinate someone else's work. You're a builder, not a maintainer. You enjoy variety — moving between hiring, trainings, founder meetings, and creative employer\-brand campaigns, vendor calls in a single day energizes you.
 



  





**Creative\-marketing instinct (key for employer branding):** 
 You think like a marketer when it comes to employer brand. You know what makes content stand out on LinkedIn \& respective digital platforms. You're not afraid to pitch unconventional ideas.
 



  





**Tech \& AI fluency:** 
 You actively use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) for JDs, screening, outreach, content drafts, and operational efficiency. You're comfortable with modern hiring stacks.
 



  





**Operational instinct:** 
 You think in systems and spot inefficiencies early. You create structure, improve team alignment, and build scalable hiring and culture processes that drive clarity and execution.
 



  





**Communication:** 
 Sharp written and verbal communication with the ability to confidently manage conversations across all levels.
 



  





**Why You'll Want This Role** 



* **Founder\-level visibility from Day 1** 
 — you report directly to the founders, no layers.
* **Build the People \& Operations function from scratch** 
 — every system, policy, and program.
* **Own employer branding as a real growth area, not an afterthought** 
 — bring your most creative ideas and ship them.
* **Real ownership across hiring, people, employer brand, and operations** 
 — four career tracks compounding in one seat.
* **AI\-first agency culture** 
 — you'll work with modern tools and modern thinking, not legacy processes.
* **Clear growth path** 
 — Talent Acquisition \& Culture Lead within 18\-24 months on strong performance.
* **Genuinely flexible** 
 — hybrid, not daily office. Travel only when needed (To Ghatkopar, Mumbai HQ \& Baner Pune.)



  





***Compensation: ₹3\-5 LPA \+ performance variable, with room to stretch for exceptional candidates***




  





**Apply If** 




 You've worked at an agency, you're hungry to own something bigger than your current role, you've got creative employer\-branding ideas you want to ship, and you want to build the People and Operations backbone at a scale\-up that's serious about doing this right. We'd love to hear from you.

 Audits \& Compliance :\- Manage and support internal and external HR audits. Ensure all HR processes are aligned with company policies and compliance standards. Prepare audit documentation and respond to audit queries. Track audit observations and ensure timely closure of action items.
   

  

 Work in a team environment to resolve customer questions or issues in broad range of HR matters Support on some of the Employee Relations subject as and when the business requires Timely reports on the various HR subjects handled Actively engage in CORE and support continuous improvement opportunities.
   

  

 Perform any other duties deemed reasonable and necessary by the business Requirements Strong HR generalist skills and relevant experience in a line HR role or COE Ability to carefully listen, probe and analyze data accompanied with sound judgment that meets organization and employee objectives
   

  

 Experience in Learning and Development, Total Rewards, Employee Relations or Reporting an advantage Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to work in teams within deadlines. Wide\-ranging understanding of current HR policy and process and able to provide advice and guidance on complex issues.
   

  

 Good understanding of local legal \& regulatory requirements required for specialized services. Personable with strong communication and relationship building capabilities across all levels of the business Practical and logical; able to solve problems quickly

**Experience**

Ability to learn processes, policies, and the ability to apply CORE principles to these processes for continuous improvement. Ability to work in a team environment. Strong attention to detail and ability to apply analytical skills. Strong communication skills (written and oral) with all levels of the organization. Education Required: Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in any stream from a recognized university
