description:
Position Description  

We’re Hiring at CGI for our GCC \- Right Here in Hyderabad!  

Join us at the intersection of technology, finance, and innovation. You will be working to support the Financial Services Group, one of the top\-tier financial institutions in the U.S. You’ll help shape digital solutions for a global enterprise—from the ground up.  

This is more than a job. It’s your opportunity to:  

* Work on cutting\-edge technologies
* Collaborate with global teams
* Build a career with purpose and impact


Ready to build the future of banking? Let’s talk.  

Position Description:  

  

Job Title: Talent Acquisition Specialist \- Recruiter Contractor  

Position: Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Specialist (Contractor)  

Experience: 4\-7 years  

Category: Human Resources  

Shift: 11AM\-8PM  

Main location: India, Telangana, Hyderabad  

Position ID: J0426\-1794  

Employment Type: 6 Months Contract  

  

Job Overview:  

CGI is looking for a talented and motivated Recruiter with strong expertise in Sourcing and Stakeholder management to build and manage scalable, efficient, and reliable data pipelines and infrastructure. You’ll play a key role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, working closely with data scientists, analysts, and business teams.**Your future duties and responsibilities**


End\-to\-End Recruitment  

Manage complete recruitment lifecycle from requisition gathering to onboarding.  

Handle sourcing, screening, interviewing coordination, salary negotiation, and offer closure.  

Work on multiple positions simultaneously with focus on quality and turnaround time.  

Understand business requirements and align recruitment strategies accordingly.  

Ensure timely delivery against hiring targets and SLAs.  

Sourcing \& Talent Mapping  

Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, internal databases, employee referrals, and networking channels.  

Build strong talent pipelines for niche and volume hiring requirements.  

Conduct market mapping and competitor analysis for critical skill hiring.  

Utilize innovative sourcing techniques to identify passive candidates.  

Screening \& Candidate Assessment  

Conduct initial HR screening to assess technical fit, communication skills, cultural fit, and salary expectations.  

Validate candidate experience, notice period, compensation, and availability.  

Coordinate technical interviews and collect interview feedback from panels.  

Maintain high standards of candidate evaluation and documentation.  

Stakeholder Management  

Partner closely with hiring managers, business leaders, and interview panels.  

Provide regular hiring updates, recruitment metrics, and pipeline status.  

Drive hiring discussions and influence decision\-making with data\-driven insights.  

Ensure smooth coordination between business, HR operations, and candidates.  

Offer Management \& Negotiation  

Handle salary discussions and negotiate compensation within approved budgets.  

Manage offer rollout, approvals, and joining formalities.  

Engage with candidates during notice period to ensure successful onboarding.  

Handle offer decline scenarios and improve candidate conversion ratio.  

Recruitment Operations \& Reporting  

Maintain accurate recruitment data in ATS and internal tracking systems.  

Prepare recruitment dashboards and status reports.  

Ensure compliance with recruitment processes and policies.  

Support process improvement initiatives to enhance hiring efficiency.

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**


Required Skills  

Strong experience in Full Life Cycle Recruitment  

Expertise in sourcing and screening methodologies  

Hands\-on experience in interview coordination and scheduling  

Strong stakeholder management and communication skills  

Experience in offer negotiation and candidate engagement  

Ability to manage multiple requirements under tight timelines  

Strong understanding of recruitment metrics and reporting  

Experience working with ATS and recruitment tools  

Excellent interpersonal and relationship management skills

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**  

  

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…  

  

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.  

  

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.  

  

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well\-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
  

  

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

title: Workforce Optimization, Associate 2
description:
**Purpose of the Role**


Support the end\-to\-end execution of global Workforce Optimization (WO) / Reduction in Force (RIF) processes. Ensure timely, accurate, and compliant delivery of workforce reduction activities while supporting impacted employees and minimizing operational and regulatory risks.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Workforce Optimization Process Execution**  

Support the preparation, validation, and execution of workforce impact files and notification cycles. Ensure timelines, data accuracy, and process adherence throughout the lifecycle.
* **Process Governance \& Compliance**  

Follow established Employee Relations and RIF governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with country\-specific labor laws and internal policies. Flag risks and escalate issues proactively.
* **Data \& Case Management**  

Review employee data related to workforce reductions (terminations, exits, transitions) and coordinate updates across HR systems (e.g., Workday, ticketing tools). Maintain accuracy and confidentiality of sensitive information.
* **Stakeholder Coordination**  

Work closely with HR Business Partners, Employee Relations, Payroll, Benefits, Finance, and Legal teams to support smooth execution of workforce reduction activities.
* **Employee Support Coordination**  

Assist in addressing employee queries and ensure appropriate routing of causes related to separations, grievances, or benefits during RIF cycles.
* **Operational Excellence**  

Adhere to defined SLAs and support tracking of key metrics (accuracy, timeliness, exceptions). Contribute to process improvements and stabilization of files early in the cycle.
* **Technology \& Tools Usage**  

Use HR systems, trackers, and digital tools effectively to manage workflow. Support adoption of automation and standardized templates.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* 2–5 years of experience in HR operations, Employee Relations, or workforce lifecycle processes
* Exposure to RIF / restructuring / workforce optimization processes is preferred
* Basic understanding of labor law and compliance requirements
* Experience in global or multi\-country environments is an advantage
* Familiarity with Workday, ticketing tools, and MS Excel

**Key Skills**

* Strong attention to detail and data accuracy
* Ability to manage timelines in a high\-pressure, deadline\-driven environment
* Good stakeholder coordination and communication skills
* Problem\-solving mindset with ability to escalate risks appropriately
* High level of confidentiality and professionalism

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
**Who is USP?**



The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.

  



At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

  



USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

  


**Brief Job Overview**

Senior Talent Acquisition Partner is a key mission enabler at USP and we’re seeking an exceptional recruiter to join our team. Our new team member will lead their hiring managers through the full lifecycle of recruiting for a variety of professional, technical, scientific, and administrative positions. Primary responsibilities involve deep partnership and with business leaders and hiring managers to effectively source, recruit, evaluate, interview, and select top Acquisition/HR projects that will strengthen USP offerings and branding as an employer of choice.

  


**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**



As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.

  



Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.

  



The Sr. TA Partner has the following responsibilities:


* Conducts full lifecycle recruiting for assigned searches beginning with a strategy meeting with the hiring manager to discuss process and strategic sourcing approach
* Creates an effective sourcing strategy based on business needs and identify candidates through standard and creative methods
* Evaluates the resumes/profiles of prospective candidates and determines degree of skill match; recommends or declines appropriately and forwards qualified short\-listed candidate resumes to the hiring manager for review.
* Tracks candidate activity from initial resume submittal to hire in the applicant tracking system (ATS);
* Coordinates receiving and evaluating of interview feedback and advises hiring manager in the final selection process.
* Collaborates with the HRBP, Compensation \& Benefits and others as needed in establishing salaries.
* Checks references, verifies educational credentials, and coordinates background investigation of selected candidate; negotiates and makes verbal and written offers of employment.
* Works with colleagues to prepare weekly reports to monitor recruitment activity, tracks vacant positions, recruiting strategies/sources, and costs.
* Support in designing and executing employer branding initiatives to position the organization as an employer of choice, leveraging digital platforms and recruitment marketing tools.
* Analyze market trends and competitor practices to continuously refine talent attraction and branding strategies.


Additional roles and responsibilities include:


* Work on visually appealing and informative quarterly Dashboards and to be presented to the Leadership.
* Share Weekly Recruitment reports with the Leadership
* Work on Contract agreements and payments with various vendors as and when required
* Align and ensure the Headcount report is in alignment with Global HR and Finance teams.
* Ensure that all Job Portals and third\-party verification contracts are up to date and be the single point of contact for recruitment needs
* Ensure Talent acquisition is always Audit Compliant.
* Support on designing Recruitment policies and Manuals when required. Identifies processes and practices for continuous improvement and champions appropriate changes as needed.

  


**Who is USP Looking For?**



The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:


* Master's Degree/Post Graduate Diploma (Full\-Time) in Human Resource Management from a business school is preferred, with 10 years of professional recruiting experience to include leadership and strategic project experience.
* Demonstrated full\-lifecycle recruitment experience working in corporate or agency environments.
* Experience in cold calling, candidate development and directly sourcing candidates from a variety of media including standard sourcing tools (social networks, corporate websites, general job boards, professional associations, agencies, college postings and alumni organizations, open houses) to build candidate pipelines
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office is required, as is familiarity with applicant tracking systems (ATS)


**Additional Desired Preferences**


* Recruitment experience within Pharmaceuticals and/or health care life sciences, biotechnology industry.
* Experience in behavioral and/or competency\-based interviewing techniques
* Advanced ability to understand complex requirements and effectively communicate with hiring managers and candidates
* Strong partnership and relationship building skills with the ability to adjust to multiple changing, and often competing, priorities
* Ability to help build a pipeline of diverse candidate to help company achieve DEIB goals
* Excellent time management, communication, and project management skills
* Superior verbal and written communication skills
* Must be able to work independently as well as in a team environment
* Strong technology orientation and skills related to social networking, sourcing techniques.
* Experience working with HRIS systems, UltiPro/UKG is a plus

  


**Supervisory Responsibilities**

  



Nil

  


**Benefits**

  



USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company\-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well\-being is protected.

  



Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

  



USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

  


**Brief Job Overview**

  




The Employee Relations Manager is responsible for fostering a positive work environment by managing employee relations programs, resolving workplace issues, and ensuring compliance with labor laws and company policies. This role serves as a trusted advisor to management and employees, promoting fairness, consistency, and engagement across the organization strengthening the compliance culture.

Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.

  



The Employee Relations Manager has the following responsibilities:

  


* Investigate and lead the people\-related issues such as: behavior/conduct concerns, corrective actions for policy violations, employee grievances, and workplace conflicts in a timely and confidential manner.
* Liaise with labor offices and regulatory authorities to ensure compliance with statutory requirements and manage audits or inspections.

* Anchor / support the compliance awareness sessions \& training on policies, risk management practices, and other emerging or specific issues to promote consistent understanding across teams.

  


**Who is USP Looking For?**



The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:


* Masters Degree/Post Graduate Diploma/Masters in Social Work (Full\-Time) in Human Resource Management.

* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills**.**

Nil

description:
**Job Description: Data Analyst Internship (2 Months)**

**Position**: Data Analyst Intern

**Experience Level**: Freshers/Students

**Company:** Career Naksha

**About us:'**

Career Naksha is an ed\-tech start\-up based company at Vadodara. Here we work as a source of support when candidates experience difficulty finding jobs and choosing the right career path and also guide the clients through counseling for the completion of aptitude ,personality, and adjacent tests. Here we are looking for the aspirantor Social Media Intern who help us build and grow our online presence

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a motivated and skilled **Data Analyst Intern** who can assist with data scraping, analysis, visualization, and research. You will have the opportunity to work on real\-world data, contribute to building data tools, and create insightful dashboards using Power BI. This internship is ideal for someone who is eager to learn and gain hands\-on experience in data analysis and business intelligence.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Data Collection \& Scraping**:
* Build Python scripts to scrape data from websites and social media platforms.
* Gather data through APIs from social media sites (e.g., Twitter, Instagram) for analysis.
* **Data Cleaning \& Analysis**:
* Clean and process raw data to ensure accuracy and usability.
* Analyze datasets to uncover trends, patterns, and actionable insights.
* Work with Python and tools like Pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib for data analysis and visualization.
* **Power BI Dashboard Creation**:
* Create dynamic dashboards in Power BI to visualize data.
* Design visual reports to communicate key insights and recommendations to stakeholders.
* **Tool Development**:
* Assist in developing automated scraping tools to collect data on an ongoing basis.
* Optimize and maintain data scraping tools for accuracy and efficiency.
* **Research**:
* Conduct research on scraping techniques, APIs, and data collection methods.
* Stay updated on the latest trends and tools for data analysis and business intelligence.

**Requirements:**

* **Education**: Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
* **Technical Skills**:
* Proficiency in **Python** for data scraping, data analysis, and automation.
* Basic understanding of **web scraping libraries** (e.g., BeautifulSoup, Scrapy).
* Familiarity with **Power BI** or any other data visualization tools.
* Knowledge of APIs for social media platforms (Twitter, Instagram, etc.) is a plus.
* **Analytical Skills**:
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical mindset.
* Ability to work with large datasets and identify trends, insights, and opportunities.
* **Research Skills**:
* Ability to research and implement various scraping and data collection techniques.
* **Communication Skills**:
* Ability to present data insights clearly and effectively.

**What You’ll Learn:**

* Hands\-on experience in data scraping, analysis, and visualization.
* Building and optimizing data tools and automated scraping systems.
* Working with real business challenges to derive meaningful insights from data.
* Creating interactive dashboards that influence decision\-making in a business context.
* Exposure to real\-world projects in a dynamic work environment.

This internship is perfect for someone looking to gain practical experience in data analysis, Python scripting, and Power BI dashboard creation. You'll be working on tasks that challenge both your technical and analytical skills while getting valuable industry exposure.

**Task Assignment for Data Analyst Internship**

As part of the application process, you are required to complete the following assignment to demonstrate your skills in data scraping, analysis, and visualization.

**Task: Data Scraping, Analysis, and VisualizationScenario:**

You are tasked with analyzing product reviews and social media engagement for a specific product category (e.g., mobile phones or laptops) across e\-commerce websites and social media platforms. The goal is to gather insights into customer sentiment, pricing trends, and engagement metrics to inform business decisions.

**Assignment Instructions:**

* **Data Scraping**:
* **Website Scraping**:
* Write a Python script to scrape product reviews and ratings from a popular e\-commerce website (such as Amazon or Flipkart). Extract the following fields:
* Product name
* Product price
* Average rating
* Number of reviews
* Review text (optional: scrape a few recent reviews)
* Store the data in a CSV file.
* **Social Media Data**:
* Use any social media platform's API (e.g., Twitter API, Instagram Graph API) to extract engagement metrics for a specific product or brand. Extract:
* Post content
* Likes, comments, shares (or retweets)
* Hashtags used
* Store the data in a structured format (CSV or JSON).
* **Data Cleaning and Analysis**:
* Clean the datasets to ensure there are no missing or incorrect values.
* Analyze the data to identify key trends, such as:
* Price trends and how they relate to customer reviews and ratings.
* The correlation between social media engagement (likes, shares) and customer sentiment in reviews.
* Insights on popular hashtags and their impact on engagement.
* **Visualization (Power BI)**:
* Import the cleaned dataset into Power BI.
* Create a dashboard that includes the following:
* A visual representation of product ratings and reviews across price ranges.
* A chart showing social media engagement metrics (e.g., likes, shares) over time.
* A correlation chart between social media posts and customer sentiment based on reviews.
* **Deliverables**:
* Submit your Python scripts for scraping both website and social media data.
* Provide the cleaned dataset (in CSV/Excel format).
* Share your Power BI dashboard (exported as a PDF or shareable Power BI link).
* Include a short document (1 page) summarizing your approach, key findings, and recommendations based on the analysis.

**Evaluation Criteria:**

* **Python Skills**: Efficiency and functionality of scraping scripts (website and social media).
* **Data Cleaning**: Quality of data cleaning and preparation for analysis.
* **Analysis \& Insights**: Depth and relevance of insights drawn from the data.
* **Power BI Dashboard**: Clarity, usability, and effectiveness of visualizations.
* **Presentation**: Clear communication of your approach, findings, and recommendation

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

title: Business Analyst
description:
**Job Purpose**
 Implement risk management processes at the ground level for the construction finance business, gaining a thorough understanding of the project and developer and preparing a credit memo to assess the project viability and proposal structure as per ABHFL risk parameters and customer requirements. Key activities are analysis of project viability, assessment of market information and developer financials.
   

  

**Job Context \& Major Challenges**
**Job Context/ Job Challenges**
 Job Context
   

  

**Key Aspects**
 The company has a well\-defined vision of being one of the most reputed and material financiers within the lending space\-spread across both retail HNI and corporate clientele. We have made significant investments in our process and system infrastructure towards preparing for the next level of growth and are one of the only financial entities certified for ISO 9001:2008 across all our business processes. Spread across 18 cities, we plan on further diversifying our risk and revenue mix through expansion into new geographies and new product segments allowing our customers a one\-window shop for all their financing needs.
   

  

 The Business Credit Analyst is an integral part of the Construction Finance Business and is responsible for analyzing the proposals with the required due diligence and to ensure that all information required to take a credit decision is captured in the proposal.
   

  

 The analyst is also responsible to ensure that proposals are compliant with all the norms of credit policy, RBI regulations and other statutory regulations.
   

  

 He/she has to maintain stipulated TAT in credit appraisal process and is also responsible for keeping update on the various changes in economic scenario, sectors, etc., co\-ordination with sales team and RMG for faster decisions to improvise TATs of the overall sanction process.
   

  

 Market Intelligence and understanding Competition best practices and suggesting changes in the existing product / policy and processes.
   

  

 Generating various MISs and EWS (early warning signals), overall portfolio monitoring form risk as well as compliance perspective is an important job aspect.
   

  

 Key Challenges
   

  

 Cross functional coordination to enable timely approval of credit proposals
   

  

 Self\-updating on economic / sectoral changes in the economy
   

  

 Improvising on TAT
   

  

 Seamless co\-ordination with multiple internal and external entities
   

  

 New product development
   

  

**Enabling Skill Sets \& Qualifications**
 The critical skill sets are a strong analytical acumen, evaluation skills, detail orientation \& decision\-making skills, initiative \& target orientation \& market intelligence developed through a strong industry network.
   

  

 The education \& experience required to fulfil this profile are a Chartered Accountant or an MBA with minimum 2\-4 years of experience in credit and risk functions of Banks/NBFCs.
   

  

**Key Result Areas**
**KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)** 
**Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)**
 KRA1 To Assess and conduct detailed credit analysis \& evaluation of lending proposals for approval / decision at the local level or further recommendation for approval/ decision to Risk team for further approval at CC level Meet with developers and builders to understand the viability of their projects, in terms of project scale, progress and financials. Provide inputs towards the structuring of the deal, ensuring compliance with internal risk and external regulatory requirements. Carry out an analysis of the balance sheet and recent financial results of developers and their organizations. Carry out background research on the project, the developer and the regional market, highlighting any negative reports so as to ensure the quality of ABHFLs lending portfoli. To interact with the Legal and Technical agencies to ensure that property risk have been understood and mitigated. Monitor statutory real estate guidelines and assess any relevant information from these sources
   

  

 KRA2 Emphasize strict compliance and adherence to internal risk management and external regulatory norms Ensure a thorough understanding and acceptance of the ABFL credit risk strategies, and ensure that appropriate credit risk parameters are incorporated in proposals. To work with the Central Risk teams to identify risk areas and build processes to mitigate risk, including performance metrics and documented procedures. Monitor customer accounts on a periodic basis to ensure the maintenance of acceptable asset quality levels. Track delinquent and potentially problematic accounts closely, taking action to minimize the level of NPAs within the region.
   

  

 KRA3 Vendor Management Identifying and recommendation for Appointment of vendors at local levels including valuation, legal, Field Investigation Agencies, Fraud Containment Agencies. Managing TAT with various vendors\- a) Field investigation, b) Lawyers, c) Technical Valuers, d) RCU agency to ensure Customer Delight. Regular Training and reviewing the performance of the vendors with regular interaction and keeping eye on the other financial institution association.
   

  

 KRA4 Process Management Ensuring that end to end processes are followed as per the SOPs as defined for CF at the local assessment level. Continuous improvement in credit approval process to meet the dynamic business needs and instituting mechanisms for adherence of risk associated with the product s, safety of financed amount and customer satisfaction. Proper capturing of data in the requisite system to ensure proper MIS generation for business decisions. Training implementation for Local Credit Process team, Sales team on product, processes, legal and technical aspects. Handling customer escalations and complaints during and post disbursements \-replies to mailers, correspondences with co\-ordination with the legal team

description:
**Job Title:** 
 Web Development Intern
   

  

**Company:** 
 Marketing Mojito
   

  

**Duration:** 
 3 Months (with a pre\-placement offer based on your performance)
   

  

**About Marketing Mojito**
 Marketing Mojito is a full\-stack digital marketing agency built for business transformation. Here, you won't be "just an employee." You'll build brands from scratch, run end\-to\-end campaigns, and watch your ideas go live. With our learning\-first culture, you'll pick up the skills that matter — strategy, performance, content, design and analytics, while owning real outcomes.
   

  

 Come for the challenge; stay for the growth.
   

  

**The Vibe:** 
 At
 **Marketing Mojito,** 
 we don't build code just for the sake of it. We buildGrowth Engines. We are looking for a
 **Web Development Intern** 
 who can look at a Figma design and turn it into a pixel\-perfect, lightning\-fast live website before the deadline hits.
   

  

**The Mission:** 
 You won't be fetching coffee or writing documentation no one reads. You will be building Landing Pages for ad campaigns, customizing Shopify stores for D2C brands, and ensuring our clients' websites pass Core Web Vitals with flying colors.
   

  

**What You'll Actually Do**
* Figma to Code: Translate UI/UX designs into responsive HTML/CSS/JS or directly into page builders (Elementor/Divi).
* CMS Mastery: Customize WordPress themes and Shopify stores. You aren't just installing plugins; you're tweaking the PHP/Liquid code to make it work exactly how we need it.
* Speed Freak: Optimize images, minify CSS/JS, and fix loading issues to ensure 90\+ PageSpeed scores.
* Bug Hunter: Troubleshoot broken layouts, 404 errors, and plugin conflicts (because they will happen).
* SEO Implementation: Work with the SEO team to implement schema markup, meta tags, and clean URL structures.


**The Stack You Need**
* Must Haves: HTML5, CSS3 (Flexbox/Grid), JavaScript (Basic DOM manipulation).
* The Agency Stack: Experience with WordPress (Elementor/WPBakery) and Shopify.
* Bonus: Knowledge of PHP, Liquid, or React.
* Tooling: Git (Version Control) and Chrome DevTools (Debugging).


**Why Marketing Mojito?**
* Ship Daily: Your code goes live. Real users interact with what you build.
* Mentorship: Code alongside seniors who solve real business problems, not just LeetCode puzzles.
* The PPO: We are growing fast. Prove your code is clean and fast, and the full\-time offer is yours.


**Apply: Send yourGitHub / Portfolio Link(Mandatory) to challengemaster@marketingmojito.om**
**If you don't have a portfolio, send a link to a site you built.**

* Helping develop training plans and materials to address the evolving development needs of various teams, supporting employee growth

* Participating in process reviews to identify opportunities for simplification and automation, driving efficiency improvements
* Compiling comprehensive personnel statistics, reports, and performance evaluations to inform decision\-making
* Partnering closely with business leaders to align HR strategies and initiatives with organizational goals and priorities

You may have the opportunity to work on projects in different HR (human resources) areas, like employee relations, training, or compensation. As an intern, you'll have the chance to apply your analytical, problem\-solving, and technical skills, as well as develop important communication and other professional soft skills, through hands\-on experience.
   

  

 You'll gain insights into how HR partners with the business to drive growth and organizational excellence. The experience you acquire will be invaluable as you embark on your HR career, providing a strong foundation in a fast\-paced, global setting.

 As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.

description:
**About PhonePe Limited:**
 Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the PhonePe digital payments app, was launched in Aug 2016\. As of April 2025, PhonePe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40\+ million) merchants. PhonePe also processes over 33 Crore (330\+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore.
   

  

 PhonePe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance, Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode \- hyperlocal e\-commerce and Indus AppStore Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India, which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.
   

  

**Culture:**
 At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe\-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
   

  

**Reporting To:** 
 Lead – Payroll and Benefits
   

  

**Role Overview:** 
 The Lead – Exit \& Benefits Administration is responsible for end\-to\-end management of employee exits and benefits administration for a high\-volume sales workforce. The role ensures timely, compliant, and accurate closure of exits and post\-exit formalities, effective administration of insurance benefits along with driving process efficiency, automation, and system\-led improvements to enable scale.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Exit Management
* Own end\-to\-end exit administration for high volume exits( 800\-1000 per week) including resignation processing, separation documentation, and system updates while ensuring payroll accuracy and compliance.
* Ensure timely and compliant closure of exits in line with statutory, payroll, and internal policy timelines.


**Coordinate with payroll, HRBPs, finance, and business teams for seamless exit execution.**
* Post\-Exit Formalities \& Documentation
* Ensure accurate and timely issuance of:
+ Relieving and experience letters
+ Full \& Final settlement inputs
+ Statutory exit documentation (PF, ESIC, gratuity where applicable)
+ Show cause and termination letters as required for the respective cases (absconding, involuntary exits, etc.)

* Maintain audit\-ready documentation and records for all exits.
* Recovery Management
* Manage employee recoveries, dues reconciliation, and write\-offs as per policy and delegated authority.

As a high\-volume, metrics\-driven center handling over 10 million contacts annually, CES is a dynamic environment where associates thrive by solving real\-world problems and creating meaningful customer experiences.

 Manage the end\-to\-end associate lifecycle, including onboarding, performance management, grievance resolution, and offboarding, with a focus on operational excellence.

 Support learning and development efforts, coordinating programs that build future\-ready skills and promote career growth.
   

  

 Coach and enable Team Leaders and Managers, helping them navigate people responsibilities, resolve team challenges, and lead with empathy and clarity.

 Prepare comprehensive reports and dashboards, tracking progress against people priorities and surfacing trends to inform future talent strategies.

 A Master’s degree in Human Resources or a related field from a reputed institution, with 5–10 years of experience in the Human Resources domain, including relevant exposure to HR Business Partnering in IT, consulting, or high\-volume service environments.

 Strong planning and problem\-solving capabilities, with a proactive approach to managing ambiguity and driving continuous improvement.
   

  

 A growth mindset and openness to embracing change, contributing to a culture of agility and innovation.
   

  

 Flexibility to work across different shift timings, including night shifts, to support CES operations and associate needs.

title: HR Operations Manager
description:
Join ABBYY and be part of a team that celebrates your unique work style. With flexible work options, a supportive team, and rewards that reflect your value, you can focus on what matters most – driving your growth, while fueling ours.
   

  

 Our commitment to respect, transparency, and simplicity means you can trust us to always choose to do the right thing.
   

  

 As a trusted partner for purpose\-built AI and intelligent automation, we solve highly complex problems for our enterprise customers and put their information to work to transform the way they do business. Over 10,000 customers trust ABBYY, including many Fortune 500 ones. You will work on further developing a portfolio already containing client names such as DHL, Johnson \& Johnson, FDA, DMV, PwC, KeyBank, Spotify, and H\&R BLOCK.
   

  

**About the Role:**
 The HR Operations Manager role is an IC and hybrid position that delivers both operational HR support and HRIS systems administration within ABBYY’s global People Shared Services team. The role provides employee and manager support, ensures consistent application of People policies across assigned regions, and contributes to efficient, compliant employee lifecycle processes.
   

  

 In parallel, this position supports the configuration, optimization, and maintenance of our core People systems, HiBob (HRIS) and Greenhouse (ATS), and plays a key role in maintaining data accuracy, improving workflows, and enabling reliable People data reporting.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving problems, improving processes, and working at the intersection of People Operations and HR technology in a global, fast\-paced environment.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities:**
**People Operations Support**
* Provide regional People Operations support for an assigned geography within the global People Shared Services team.
* Ensure global People policies and workflows are applied appropriately within the region, accounting for local compliance requirements.
* Respond to employee and manager inquiries through our case management system (AskABBYY), meeting all SLAs with timely, accurate, and high\-quality support.
* Process global HR lifecycle transactions, including onboarding, job changes, compensation adjustments, leaves, and offboarding.
* Maintain employee data in our People systems of record through validation, updates, and reconciliations.
* Partner cross\-functionally to ensure coordinated employee lifecycle support.


**HRIS and ATS Systems Administration (HiBob and Greenhouse)**
* Support configuration and ongoing management of HiBob (HRIS) and Greenhouse (ATS), including workflows, permissions, automations, custom fields, templates, and lifecycle processes.
* Translate business requirements into technical system changes, implementing enhancements and new features as needed.
* Troubleshoot system issues and partner with internal teams or vendors to resolve them.
* Serve as a knowledgeable resource on system functionality, best practices, and platform capabilities.


**Data Quality, Reporting \& Analytics**
* Ensure accuracy and integrity of employee data across all People systems.
* Conduct data audits and reconciliations and resolve discrepancies.
* Support the creation and maintenance of scheduled and ad hoc People data reports and dashboards.
* Address data integration issues between People systems and downstream systems such as payroll, IT, or Finance tools.


**Process \& Documentation Support**
* Create and maintain SOPs, workflows, system documentation, and user guides.
* Document system configurations and data processes to ensure clarity and consistency.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and standardization across regions.
* Ensure all documentation reflects current policies, systems, and operational practices.


**Job Requirements:**
* 6\+ years of experience in People Operations, HR Operations, HRIS administration, or a similar hybrid role.
* Experience with HiBob (or another modern HRIS) and Greenhouse strongly preferred.
* Solid understanding of HR processes and the employee lifecycle.
* Experience supporting global or multi\-country populations.
* Strong analytical skills, including reporting or data interpretation experience.
* High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Ability to translate business needs into system or operational requirements.
* Strong customer service orientation and ability to provide timely, helpful support.
* Effective communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills.


**Here are some of our local benefits:**
* Comprehensive medical, accidental, and life insurance
* Weekly wellness sessions to support your physical and mental well\-being
* A generous paid time off policy


**Join ABBYY, and you will:**
**Love How You Work**
* We provide remote and hybrid working options to fit all lifestyles.
* We use flexible hours across most of our teams to allow you to find your own definition of balance.
* Encouraging a culture of giving, we provide two paid volunteering days off every year so you can take time to contribute to the causes you care about.
* To ensure your family is cared for, we offer paid parental leave in all our locations.


**Love Whom You Work With**
* We are a global team of 600\+ colleagues, spread across 15 countries on four continents.
* With colleagues representing 30\+ nationalities, our workforce reflects the world.
* Innovation and excellence run through our veins. Our teams gather the expertise which has garnered ABBYY more than 140 technology patents.
* We are guided by the values of respect, transparency, and simplicity.
* "Team Environment" is in the top three highest\-scoring drivers of engagement across all of our departments.


**Love What You Work On**
* We are a company with more than 35 years of experience in the technology market;
* Over 10,000 customers trust ABBYY, including many Fortune 500 ones, with names such as DHL, Johnson \& Johnson, FDA, DMV, PwC, KeyBank, Spotify, and H\&R BLOCK;
* We have modernized the capture market by creating the first low\-code/no\-code IDP platform.
* Our Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision Technologies, and a marketplace built with AI, can transform any document in any process;
* Top Analyst firms recognize ABBYY's market leadership, including Gartner, Everest PEAK Matrix ® Assessment, ISG Intelligent Automation Lens, and NelsonHall, amongst others.


*ABBYY is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that values the strength that diversity brings to the workplace. To learn more about our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion, check out the careers section on our website.*

title: HR Lead, NIRA
description:
Join the Tilt team
   

  

 At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile\-first products and machine learning\-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real\-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide
 **,** 
 we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.
   

  

 We’re looking for a
 **HR Lead** 
 to lead People Operations for our India business \- NIRA.
   

  

 This is a high\-impact role where you’ll own HR for India — partnering closely with local leadership and our global People team to build a strong, compliant, and scalable employee experience.
   

  

 Based in
 **Bangalore (hybrid)** 
 , you’ll lead a small team while acting as the trusted HR partner for employees and managers across the organization.
   

  

**Location:** 
**Bangalore, India (hybrid)**
 How you'll make an impact
   

  

* Own HR operations in India — payroll, benefits, and day\-to\-day people processes
* Ensure full statutory compliance (PF, ESI, gratuity, and employment law)
* Act as the go\-to HR partner for employees and managers
* Lead and develop a local HR team
* Support onboarding, performance, and employee growth initiatives
* Maintain clean, accurate HR data and reporting
* Partner with global teams to support hiring and scaling efforts


 Why you're a great fit
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in HR, with strong India operations expertise
* Deep understanding of compliance, payroll, and employment law in India
* Experience managing HR end\-to\-end in a growing organization
* Strong stakeholder management and employee trust\-building skills
* Experience leading and coaching team members
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, evolving environment


 Our Interview Process
   

  

**Initial Recruiter Call:** 
 A conversation to learn about your experience and what you're looking for in your next role.
   

  

**Hiring Manager Interview:** 
 A deeper discussion about your experience.
   

  

**Skills Panel:** 
 Meet with Tilt team members to discuss your expertise and problem\-solving approach.
   

  

**Leadership Conversation:** 
 A final conversation with a leader to discuss how you'll contribute to Tilt's mission, and how we can help you achieve your career goals along the way
   

  

**Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.**
**What You'll Get At Tilt**
* Virtual\-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.
* Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.
* Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.
* Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.
* Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)
* Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.


**The Tilt Way**
 We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non\-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the \[virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.
   

  

**You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.**

 **qualified and experienced HR Manager**

You will also be involved in developing and implementing HR strategies and initiatives that align with the overall business goals and vision.
 



  





 As an HR Manager, you will be the go\-to person for all employee\-related issues and queries. You will foster a positive and productive work environment where everyone works to achieve our mission and objectives. You will also promote our corporate values and culture and ensure that they are reflected in our policies and procedures.
 



  





 To be successful in this role, you should have a solid background in human resources management, as well as excellent communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills. You should also have a strong knowledge of US labor laws and regulations, HR best practices, and industry trends.  : Night shift (8 to 4PM EST)

* Collaborate with senior management and other departments to align HR objectives and initiatives with the overall business strategy and vision
* Evaluate and improve HR processes and systems, and recommend and implement changes and enhancements
* Stay updated on the latest HR trends and best practices, and participate in professional networks and events



  
 



**Requirements:** 



* Bachelor's degree in human resources, business administration, or a related field
* **Minimum of 5 years of proven experience as an HR Manager** 
 or a similar senior\-level HR role for an information technology company
* Professional certification in human resources, such as SHRM\-CP, SHRM\-SCP, PHR, or SPHR, is preferred
* In\-depth knowledge of human resources principles, practices, and legal aspects, such as labor laws, employment standards, and compliance requirements
* Proficient in MS Office and HR software, such as Workday, BambooHR, or ADP
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with different audiences and stakeholders
* Strong leadership, management, and organizational skills, with the ability to plan, prioritize, and execute multiple tasks and projects
* High level of integrity, confidentiality, and professionalism, with the ability to handle sensitive and confidential information and situations
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively, and adapt to changing needs and demands
* Creative and innovative thinker, with a passion for human resources and people development

**About The Health Insurance Industry –**
 While the current market sees more than 15 non\-life players in the private space and 5 exclusive private players in the health insurance space trying to capture a sizable market share, the nationalised service provider (6\) remains a strong competitor. In addition to this the business dynamics are such that the overall market on an annual basis which is to the tune of roughly 10,000 Crs sees close to 85 % of the business renewing with the existing service provider itself. This narrows down the opportunity of the fresh business actually being seriously fought in the market to approximately 1500 odd Crs. With the SME and the start\-ups being the driving force of Indian economy, the opportunity to cater to these segments is immense and is increasing manifold year on year. The challenge here therefore remains as to how we capture a larger share of the opportunity by developing specific solutions to cater each segment of the business. Also by creating an inexpensive and standardized solution to increase the reach into the pockets of channel partners across the country to harness on their captive business and explore new opportunities with them.
   

  

 Market Opportunities – With the advent of medical advancements, lifestyle changes, change in Indian socio\-economic scenario and Indian healthcare space, and the insurers are facing challenges to cater to the needs of this diverse clientele. Increasingly Indian customers have started considering health insurance partners as intentions of health advisers. In this scenario it becomes extremely important to understand their psyche and then provide tailored solutions with wellness benefits which would help them meet their end objectives and bring in profitable revenue source for the company.
   

  

**About The Aditya Birla Health Insurance –**
 Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited (ABHICL) was incorporated in 2015 as a 51:49 joint venture between Aditya Birla Capital Limited (ABCL) and MMI Strategic Investments (Pty) Ltd. ABHICL commenced its operations in October 2016\.
   

  

 ABHICL has entered the competitive health insurance market with an aim to expand the category to wider customer segments, beyond the ones that health insurance companies traditionally have marketed to. As the 6 th entrant in a category with well\-established players, ABHICL is creating differentiation and equity for itself though the unique business proposition of “Health Insurance for All”, a one\-of\-a\-kind proposition in India at the moment. This is a philosophy that is being built through every single consumer touch point and into every single backend process of the company to ensure a customer’s experience of our proposition is continuous and seamless.
   

  

 ABHI’s unique offering to market includes proposition includes \-
   

  

* A Comprehensive Incentivized Wellness Program that will attract the young and health conscious and will motivate, guide and reward them to stay healthy.
* A Chronic Care Management Program to cater to the unmet needs of a growing Indian population of those suffering from chronic lifestyle conditions like Diabetes, Asthma, High Cholesterol and Hypertension from Day 1
* ABHICL serves as an enabler and influencer of health and healthcare choices that customers make, in addition to being a payer of healthcare expenses. Thus, ABHICL would act like a much needed catalyst to grow the prevalent health insurance landscape in India through product innovations and a wider choice of consumer relevant products.
* ABHICL’s vision has always been digital. The company has been successful in adopting paper\-less approach right from identifying to on\-boarding to delivering seamless experience of its customers \& employees.

title: People Operations
description:
We Are:
   

  

 At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self\-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high\-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.
   

  

 You Are:
   

  

 You are an accomplished People Operations professional with a passion for transforming HR processes and enhancing employee experience at every stage of the lifecycle. Your expertise spans the full spectrum of HR, from Talent Acquisition and Onboarding to Performance Management, Total Rewards, Employee Relations, HR Operations, and Offboarding. You thrive in dynamic environments and excel at evaluating current\-state operations, identifying opportunities for improvement, and architecting scalable, future\-proof solutions that balance efficiency, compliance, and organizational effectiveness.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing:**
* Support large\-scale HR transformation initiatives such as shared services implementation, digital transformation, or post\-merger integration.
* Lead the end\-to\-end design, optimization, and documentation of HR processes across Talent Acquisition, Onboarding, Performance Management, Total Rewards, Employee Relations, HR Operations, and Offboarding.
* Conduct comprehensive assessments of existing HR operations, identifying gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for process harmonization and standardization.
* Develop structured process maps, workflow documentation, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), job aids, templates, and toolkits to enable scalable, enterprise\-wide HR practices.
* Facilitate structured process discovery activities, including stakeholder interviews, cross\-functional workshops, and workflow analysis sessions to capture operational realities.
* Lead and manage cross\-functional HR transformation projects, including defining scope, setting milestones, managing project risks, and ensuring on\-time delivery of key initiatives.
* Partner with HR Centers of Excellence, HR Business Partners, Shared Services, and HRIS teams to align process design with technology enablement and service delivery models.


 The Impact You Will Have:
   

  

* Elevate the efficiency and effectiveness of HR operations, contributing directly to Synopsys’ ability to attract, engage, and retain top talent.
* Enhance employee experience by streamlining and standardizing critical HR processes across the organization.
* Drive process harmonization and reduce operational variability, enabling scalable growth and business agility.
* Enable data\-driven decision\-making through clear, structured process documentation and improved process visibility.
* Support compliance and risk mitigation by ensuring HR processes adhere to regulatory and organizational standards.
* Empower business leaders and HR stakeholders with tools and resources to effectively manage people practices in a rapidly evolving environment.


 What You’ll Need:
   

  

* Extensive experience of 8\-10 years leading HR process design, transformation, and optimization initiatives across the full employee lifecycle.
* Bachelor’s/ Masters’s degree in Human Resource or equivalent.
* Proven ability to evaluate current\-state HR operations and architect scalable, future\-state processes that drive efficiency and compliance.
* Deep expertise in developing enterprise\-grade HR documentation, including process maps, SOPs, job aids, and toolkits.
* Demonstrated ability to drive process harmonization across multiple business units, regions, or legacy operating models.
* Experience supporting large\-scale HR transformation initiatives such as shared services, operating model redesign, or digital transformation.
* Advanced analytical, written, and verbal communication skills; ability to translate complex workflows into clear, actionable documentation.


 Who You Are:
   

  

* A collaborative team player who thrives in matrixed and evolving environments.
* An effective communicator who can influence and build alignment with senior stakeholders.
* Detail\-oriented, analytical, and highly organized, with a commitment to quality and continuous improvement.
* Adaptable and resilient, able to navigate ambiguity and drive change in fast\-paced settings.
* Empathetic, with a strong customer\-service orientation and a passion for enhancing the employee experience.
* Curious, proactive, and eager to stay at the forefront of HR innovation and best practices.


 The Team You’ll Be A Part Of:
   

  

 You’ll join a high\-impact, forward\-thinking People Operations team dedicated to driving HR excellence and transformation at Synopsys. The team collaborates closely with HR Centers of Excellence, Business Partners, Shared Services, and HRIS to deliver integrated, technology\-enabled solutions that support the company’s growth and strategic objectives. You’ll be surrounded by passionate professionals who are committed to continuous improvement and to making Synopsys a great place to work for all.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits:
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

 We employ a global workforce of 5,800\+ people across 25 jurisdictions and have assets under administration (AUA) exceeding US$750 billion. We work with 13 of the world’s top 15 private equity firms.

 We’re driven by our Group purpose, to power people and possibilities.

 The Global Client Delivery HR Team are like skilled teachers, they help both the 'strugglers' and the 'stars' by guiding our employees throughout their careers and ensuring that our people have every opportunity to succeed.  As HR Operations Officer, you will be part of a team delivering an excellent HR service to the UK and Ireland cluster. Within this role you will act as the first port of call to employees for all HR related queries ensuring the needs of our people are being met.
   

  

* You'll act as the first point of contact for HR administration queries, delivering accurate, timely support while building strong stakeholder and customer relationships.
* You'll manage the full employee lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, internal movements, and visa administration) while maintaining compliant and well\-organised employee records.
* You'll ensure high attention to detail in payroll data input, benefits administration, HR database updates, and employee file management.
* You'll generate HR reports and metrics (e.g., absence) and continuously optimise processes to improve efficiency and accuracy.
* You'll support HR Business Partners, advise managers and employees on policies, and align priorities across stakeholders while communicating clearly and effectively.


**What We Offer**
* Comprehensive remuneration: Competitive financial packages based upon market rates for your role, proportionate to your qualifications, level of experiences and skills profile
* Pension Scheme: Generous employer contribution with the ability to increase employee contributions
* Wellbeing: Additional social benefits such as medical insurance \& life assurance, discounted gym memberships and the opportunity to engage with our local community via sports activities, charity programmes \& environmental initiatives
* Flexible working: We recognise the value of working flexibly and enable our employees to enjoy an excellent work\-life blend
* Support and development: We will ensure you have the right training, tools and development plan to grow and improve your skills every day.


**Qualifications**
* You demonstrate proactiveness, a strong drive to succeed, and a willingness to continuously learn within a professional services environment.
* You hold a relevant third\-level qualification (HR, Business, Legal, or similar) and bring 1–2 years of HR administration experience.
* You maintain a high level of accuracy and attention to detail across all tasks and responsibilities.
* You are proficient in MS Office, particularly MS Excel, and have working knowledge of HR systems.
* You are flexible, collaborative, and able to work effectively as part of a team while supporting shared goals.

**OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU AND THE ENVIRONMENT**
 As a forward\-looking business, sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining meaningful, long\-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.
   

  

 There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee.
   

  

 Our learning and development programmes and systems enable us to invest in growing our employees’ careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our 5,800\+ employees \- from 94 nationalities, speaking 41 languages across 25 countries \- to each achieve their potential. Through IQ\-EQ Launchpad we support female managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced.
   

  

 We’re committed to growing long\-term relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our client’s sustainability and success leads to our sustainability and success. We’re emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

title: Data Associate
description:
**Company Description** 




 Mentora Institute, based in New York, is a global leader in leadership development and organizational transformation. Dedicated to empowering individuals and teams to achieve breakthrough performance, Mentora integrates the science of human potential into sustainable, mission\-driven leadership and culture\-building initiatives. Its services include C\-suite consulting, culture transformation strategies, and customized learning experiences. Backed by a team of experts in behavioral research, corporate leadership, and analytics, Mentora partners with organizations to foster measurable improvements in performance and organizational excellence.
 



  





**Job Overview:** 




 We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented fresher to join our team as a 
 **Data \& Excel Associate** 
 . If you’re someone who loves making sense of numbers, picks things up quickly, and gets a little excited when a spreadsheet finally clicks — we’d love to hear from you.
 



 You don’t need to have everything figured out. We care far more about how you think and how fast you learn than about ticking every box on a skills list. If you’re hungry to grow, you’ll thrive here.
 



  





**WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING** 




  





**Day\-to\-day, you’ll be helping the team stay on top of our data — keeping things clean, organised, and easy to understand. Here’s a flavour of what that looks like:** 




  





**•    Organising and updating data in Excel and Google Sheets, making sure everything is accurate and easy to use** 




**•    Building simple reports, charts, and summaries that help the team understand how our campaigns are performing** 




**•    Spotting patterns or inconsistencies in data and flagging them — good eye for detail goes a long way here** 




**•    Putting together visual dashboards (using tools like Power BI or Tableau — we’ll help you get comfortable if you’re not already)** 




**•    Supporting the marketing team with day\-to\-day data tasks so they can focus on the big picture** 




**•    Helping translate numbers into plain\-language takeaways — “what does this actually mean for us and how can we do better?”** 




  





**SKILLS THAT WOULD HELP** 




**Here’s what we’re ideally looking for — but please don’t hesitate if you don’t have all of it.** 




  





**•    Comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets — things like filters, pivot tables, and basic formulas** 




**•    Some exposure to data visualisation tools like Power BI or Tableau (even from a course or project is great)** 




**•    Good attention to detail — you notice when something looks off** 




**•    Any familiarity with email marketing is a bonus — even if it's just knowing your way around a tool like email marketing tool or having helped put together an email campaign** 




**•    A curious mind — you ask “why” and like figuring things out** 




**•    Clear communicator — you can explain what data is saying in simple terms, and ask questions if stuck** 




**•    Organised and reliable — you follow through and meet deadlines** 




  





**DON’T HAVE EVERY SKILL? APPLY ANYWAY.** 




**Our team is built on a growth mindset — we hire for attitude and potential, not just existing skills. If you’re a fast learner, open to feedback, and genuinely curious about data, you’ll fit right in.** 




**We’ll give you the tools, time, and support to grow into the role. What we can’t teach is drive and enthusiasm — and if you have those, the rest will follow.** 




  





**YOU’D BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU…** 




  





**•    Are a recent graduate in any field** 




**•    Have played around with Mid to advanced Excel, Google Sheets, or any data tool** 




**•    Like making things neat, clear, and easy to understand** 




**•    Get energised by learning something new, not overwhelmed by it** 




**•    Want a role where your work actually makes a visible difference to a team** 




  





**WHAT YOU’LL GET FROM THIS ROLE** 




  





**•    A real, hands\-on learning experience from day one — no busywork** 




**•    A supportive team that invests in your growth** 




**•    Exposure to how a marketing team actually uses data to make decisions** 




**•    A place to build skills in reporting, visualisation, and data storytelling** 




**•    Room to take on more responsibility as you grow — quickly, if that’s what you want** 




  





***If this sounds like you — even a little bit — just apply. We’d love to have a conversation.***

title: System Administrator
description:
**About CynLr** 




  





 Just like a baby’s brain, CynLr Visual Intelligence stack makes Robots to
 **instinctively see \& pick any object under any ambience, without any training. Demo Video** 




 Today, a robot that can fit a screw into a nut without slipping a thread, doesn’t exist. Imagine what it would take for a robot to
 **assemble a Smartphone** 
 or a car by putting together 1000s of parts with varied shapes and weights, all in random orientations. Thus, factories become complex, needing heavy customization of their environment.
 



 CynLr\-enabled visual robots intuitively learn to handle even unknown objects, on\-the\-fly, eliminating the need for rigid fixtures, pre\-training, or environment customization. This enables an universal alternative to custom automation thus simplifying factory lines into modular LEGO\-like micro\-factories that can be rapidly reconfigured as products change.
 



 At the core of CynLr lies a fundamentally new approach to machine vision. Unlike conventional vision systems that rely on image recognition and heuristics, CynLr’ s Vision and ML stacks are deeply inspired by neuroscience, modelling how biological vision understands shape, geometry, and interaction rather than appearance alone. To support this, CynLr builds its hardware, sensors, compute pipelines, and learning stacks from scratch, tightly coupling perception, decision\-making, and action.
 



 This integration allows CynLr to operate in conditions that defeat traditional automation: variable lighting, cluttered environments, unknown objects, and high precision manipulation, unlocking automation use cases that have remained unsolved for decades. By rethinking vision as an intelligent, adaptive sense rather than a static tool, CynLr is redefining how robots perceive, reason, and interact with the physical world.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




  





 As a
 *System Administrator at CynLr* 
 , you will design, build, and evolve IT infrastructure, processes, and practices that support research, product development, and operations, while ensuring efficient, secure, and sustainable usage. Process for the sake of process will not be entertained;
 *utility and convenience take precedence, and every system must justify its existence by improving real outcomes.* 





  





 CynLr's ambition demands not only breakthrough algorithms and hardware, but also a
 *robust, adaptive, and human\-centric IT infrastructure* 
 that allows teams to operate with minimal friction and maximum focus. As CynLr scales across disciplines, tools, and geographies,
 *IT infrastructure becomes the information backbone of the organization.* 
 The goal of this role is not merely uptime or compliance, but to
 *augment human productivity* 
 , eliminate hidden delays and context\-switching costs, and ensure that technology remains an enabler rather than a constraint.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





***A. Operate***




  




* Run and maintain IT infrastructure supporting research, engineering, and operations at scale.
* Administer the Office 365 ecosystem (SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, identity and access).
* Operate and secure endpoint devices across Windows, Android, BYOD, and corporate assets.
* Manage network infrastructure including routers, switches, firewalls, Wi\-Fi, and VPNs.
* Perform hands\-on monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident resolution across hardware, OS, network, and applications.



  





***B. Build***




  




* Design and deploy Azure AD, Intune, and SharePoint policies for secure and organized access.
* Set up and maintain hardware infrastructure—laptops, workstations, servers, networking, and conferencing systems.
* Configure and support Windows Server, Linux, virtualization platforms (VMware / Hyper\-V).
* Establish remote workflows and inter\-office connectivity to enable distributed teams.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with hardware, software, and service vendors.



  





***C. Improve***



* Automate workflows and remediation using PowerShell scripting to reduce manual effort.
* Evaluate and select hardware and software based on supportability, ecosystem maturity, scalability, and lifecycle cost.
* Proactively monitor systems, analyse failures, and implement preventive and reliability improvements.
* Continuously refine IT processes and practices to remove friction and improve user productivity.



  





**Team Structure:** 



* The Operations team at CynLr functions as a
 *cross\-functional enablement layer* 
 that supports Engineering, Product, and Business teams in executing reliably and at scale. Within this structure, Technology and Systems responsibilities are owned as a core operational capability, ensuring that digital infrastructure, tools, and access evolve in step with how the organization works.
* Systems and IT operations are designed to be
 *deeply integrated into day\-to\-day execution* 
 , preserving context across teams and workflows. The function works closely with Engineering to support research and development needs, and with Operations and Finance to ensure reliability, security, and long\-term sustainability.



  





**What You’ll Need to Do This Well** 



* Strong understanding of computer hardware and workstations: CPU, memory, storage, BIOS/firmware and
 *how configuration choices impact developer productivity and system reliability.*
* Deep familiarity with
 *office productivity and collaboration systems,* 
 and the ability to
 *design workflows that reduce friction and context switching* 
 rather than add process overhead.
* Solid grounding in
 *networking fundamentals* 
 (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, firewalls) relevant to office, lab, and inter\-office environments.
* Clear understanding of
 *device configuration, identity management, and user access policies, balancing usability with security.*
* Working knowledge of
 *security principles, data protection, and basic database concepts,* 
 sufficient to design safe and scalable internal systems.



  





**Experience That Will Accelerate You** 



* Hands\-on experience with
 *DevOps or internal tooling infrastructure* 
 , especially in environments where tooling is still evolving.
* Experience setting up and maintaining databases or data services used internally by teams.
* Exposure to building IT systems in
 *fast\-moving, resource\-constrained environments where requirements change frequently.*
* *Experience supporting engineering\-heavy teams* 
 , including compute\-intensive workflows, development environments, and high\-performance workstations



  





**What will you do?** 



* You will design and operate the
 *digital infrastructure that enables CynLr’s teams to work without friction* 
 . Your role is to ensure that systems, tools, and access models support how people actually work across research, engineering, operations, and business functions.
* You will
 *translate organizational needs into reliable, secure, and intuitive IT systems, spanning devices, networks, collaboration tools, identity, and internal workflows* 
 . From onboarding a new team member to supporting compute\-heavy engineering setups, your work ensures that infrastructure never becomes the bottleneck to progress.
* You will proactively identify inefficiencies, hidden delays, and context\-switching costs in everyday workflows, and redesign systems to remove them so that teams can focus on solving hard problems, not fighting tools.



  





**How will you do it?** 



* The role demands a
 *systems\-first, entrepreneurial approach* 
 , suited to a deep\-tech environment where requirements evolve rapidly and standard enterprise playbooks often fall short.
* You will build strong context by working closely with teams, understanding how infrastructure decisions affect productivity, security, and reliability. You will question existing practices when they add friction, and design modular, scalable solutions that can adapt as CynLr grows.
* You will have the autonomy to rethink how systems are designed, deployed, and operated, with outcomes reviewed through the lens of
 *execution quality, reliability, usability, and long\-term sustainability.* 
 Success in this role comes from balancing hands\-on execution with thoughtful design solving today’s problems while building infrastructure that remains robust tomorrow.
