title: Senior Manager - Enterprise Sales
description:
Internshala is India's largest platform for college students and fresher talent, trusted by over 180,000 businesses for entry\-level hiring. Internshala is now building an end\-to\-end enterprise early career talent marketplace platform accounts across GCC, BFSI, IT, and other sectors.
 



 This is a founder\-backed, high\-conviction build. The B2B charter is owned directly by the CEO, and this hire is central to establishing Internshala's Enterprise revenue from the ground up.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 We are building our Enterprise Mid and Large sales motion. This is a role for a builder \- someone who can open doors in organisations that have never engaged with Internshala, build relationships at the CHRO and TA Head, Campus Hiring and Employer Branding level, and close large deals in a challenger brand environment.
 



 If you've spent your career selling established brands and need a warm market to operate in, this role is not for you but if you're hungry, commercially sharp, and ready to earn a market position \- read on.
 



  





**What will you do?** 



* Own and build the Enterprise Account pipeline in your portfolio across allocated regions or nationally.
* Identify, engage, and close senior HR decision\-makers — CHROs, TA Heads, Employer Branding, Campus Hiring and Business heads— across target accounts.
* Self\-generate leads through outbound outreach, referrals, and on\-ground relationship building. This is a hunter role.
* Run end\-to\-end sales cycles — from prospecting and discovery to proposal, negotiation, and onboarding.
* Run consultative discovery sessions with senior HR stakeholders to map hiring pain points and design solutions — not pitch decks.
* Work with internal teams (product, marketing, ops) to deliver a strong post\-sale experience and build reference accounts.
* Maintain rigorous pipeline discipline using CRM (HubSpot) — activity logging, deal stage hygiene, weekly reporting.
* Track competitor activity and market signals, and feed insights back to the leadership team.



  





 💯 Who are we looking for?
 



**Non\-negotiables:** 



* 5–12 years of B2B sales experience, with at least 3 years selling to senior HR buyers (CHRO, TA Head, Campus Hiring heads, Employer Branding).
* Proven track record of self\-generating leads and closing enterprise deals — not relying on inbound or brand pull.
* Demonstrated ability to sell a challenger brand. You would need the right prospecting and influencing skills to open doors.
* Consultative selling approach — you diagnose before you pitch, and you build solutions around the client's hiring reality, not a fixed product deck.
* Strong consultative instinct — ability to listen, diagnose, and position solutions that map to the client's specific hiring and talent challenges.
* Strong commercial acumen — you understand deal structure, negotiation, and how to protect margin.



**Good to have:** 



* Active network within GCCs in Bangalore or Hyderabad (for Bangalore role).
* Active network within BFSI or FMCG accounts in Mumbai (for Mumbai role).
* Experience in HRTech, L\&D, assessments, or recruitment platforms — you understand the buyer's world.



  





**What do we offer in return?** 



* A genuine path to regional leadership — this role is IC today. High performers will earn the Region Lead designation through results, not tenure.
* The backing of the upGrad group and its ecosystem — brand, capital, and distribution.
* The opportunity to build something from zero. If that excites you, you'll thrive here.



  





**Location** 
 \- Bangalore, Mumbai \& Gurgaon
 



  





**Compensation** 
 \- Competitive fixed compensation \+ performance\-linked incentives (structure to be shared with shortlisted candidates)
 



  





**Start date** 
 \- Immediately

title: Software Engineer -Backend
description:
* Are you curious, excited by experimentation and always looking to innovate?
* Do you want to work in embedded payments where you can keep learning and developing whilst getting hands\-on experience?
* Do you want to have the opportunity to play an important role in a rapidly growing and exciting Fintech business?


 If so, we would love to connect and collaborate!
   

  

 We want to hire ambitious, and value\-adding talent into Modulr, one of the fastest growing payments businesses in the UK and Europe. Modulr is experiencing significant growth, and in this role you will work in a cross\-functional team who are asked to solve a problem, rather than be handed a task to do. This is an excellent opportunity to work in a high\-growth environment with a fast\-paced and collaborative culture where you will have great opportunities to work on challenging problems.
   

  

**About Us**
 At Modulr, our vision is a world where all businesses are powered by embedded payments. Modulr enables businesses, from SMEs to Enterprise, initially across the UK and Europe to efficiently pay\-in, collect and disburse funds instantly via a range of payment schemes, accounts, and card products.
   

  

 We have created an industry\-leading API platform with comprehensive online tools and access, to meet the demands of daily business payments. We have two routes to market. Our Core Business Payments product allows customers in any sector to connect to us and our expanding network of accounting and payroll platforms, including Sage, Xero, BrightPay and IRIS to automate payments. Our Vertical Solutions targets a growing range of industry verticals which directly connect their IT platforms to our APIs and webhooks. We solve complex payment problems for hundreds of clients in a range of industries, including Travel, Lending, Wage Advance, and Investment \& Wealth.
   

  

 We are deeply integrated into the payment eco\-system. In the UK, we are direct participants of Faster Payments and Bacs. Modulr hold settlement accounts at the Bank of England. Our payment network connectivity includes CHAPS, Open Banking, SEPA, SWIFT and account issuance in multiple currencies. We are principal issuing members of Visa and Mastercard schemes across UK and Europe.
   

  

 Our regulatory permissions and governance structure are the foundations of our business. We are regulated and supervised as an Authorised Electronic Money Institution (AEMI) in the UK by the Financial Conduct Authority and in the Netherlands by De Nederlandsche Bank.
   

  

 Our founding team has a wealth of experience in the payments industry and growing successful businesses. Modulr is backed by the venture arms of payments giants PayPal and FIS, as well as growth investors Blenheim Chalcot, General Atlantic, Frog Capital and Highland Europe.
   

  

 Modulr now has over 400 employees spread globally across offices in London, Edinburgh, Amsterdam, Mumbai and Pune.
   

  

**Modulr values**
* Building the extraordinary; going that extra mile.
* Owning the opportunity; be passionate and proud of the time you invest.
* Move at pace; reach goals faster whilst supported on your career journey.
* Achieve it together, working collaboratively and being a Modulite.


**The Team**
 At Modulr we are focused on building autonomous squads that are focused on working in
   

  

 the best possible way. We operate in a tribes and squad model with each area focused on
   

  

 a particular growth area. Each squad is small and cross\-functional. We have big ambitions and have many interesting challenges ahead.
   

  

**Summary**
 In this role you will design, build, and evolve the next generation of Modulr’s event\-driven payments platform. You’ll work across the full engineering lifecycle—from shaping technical approaches to delivering production\-grade software—within a squad that values ownership, excellence, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Specific duties
   

  

**Engineering \& Architecture**
* Design and develop backend services using Java (17\+) or similar OO languages.
* Build and evolve microservices and distributed, event\-driven components in a cloud\-native environment.
* Contribute to architectural patterns that support throughput, resilience, reliability, and observability.
* Design clean, well\-documented RESTful APIs and service contracts.
* Work with relational data stores, especially PostgreSQL, and contribute to data modelling.


 Distributed Systems \& Reliability
   

  

* Engineer solutions for concurrency, idempotency, fault tolerance, retries, and high availability.
* Improve system performance, reduce latency, and identify bottlenecks across services.
* Build systems with strong observability—logs, metrics, tracing—ensuring issues can be diagnosed quickly.


**Quality \& Testing**
* Develop comprehensive automated tests using frameworks such as JUnit, Mockito, Cucumber.
* Participate in design and code reviews, helping raise engineering standards across the team.
* Advocate for code quality, maintainability, and long\-term technical health.


 DevOps, Cloud \& Tooling
   

  

* Use and improve deployment pipelines and operational tooling (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, AWS services).
* Contribute to internal frameworks, shared libraries, and engineering best practices.
* Help shape the evolution of our platform toward a more flexible, modern architecture.


 Collaboration \& Delivery
   

  

* Work in an agile environment, contributing to planning, design discussions, and iterative delivery.
* Collaborate across squads to shape technical solutions that span multiple systems.
* Document best practices, reference architectures, and design approaches others can rely on.


**About You**
 You’re an engineer who thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment and enjoys solving complex, system\-level problems. You bring:
   

  

* Expertise in Java or another OO language with willingness to work in Java.
* Strong understanding of OOP, design patterns, and distributed systems fundamentals.
* Experience building and operating microservices in production.
* Ability to reason about concurrency, performance, and system behaviour under load.
* Clear, proactive communication and a collaborative, team\-first mindset.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills supported by sound engineering judgement.
* Ability to manage complexity, balance competing priorities, and deliver high\-quality work.
* A growth mindset—you enjoy learning, improving, and helping others grow.
* A self\-starter attitude with a passion for ownership and continuous improvement.


**ModInclusion**
 At Modulr, we are working hard to build a more positive diverse and inclusive culture that helps everyone to feel they belong and can truly bring their whole self to work. Not only is it the right thing to do for everyone in the Modulr team, it’s also the right thing to do for our business, the community we operate in and attracting future talent. As part of our approach, we actively welcome applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds.

title: Software Engineer, Payments
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
   

  

**The Community You Will Join**
* The Regional Payments team is the engine driving Airbnb’s global growth through deep local understanding. We believe that to truly belong anywhere, guests need a frictionless checkout experience with the payment options they know and trust.


 Our mission is to unlock regional growth by tailoring the payment journey to local needs. From offering the right mix of local payment methods to powering affordability initiatives like installment plans and partner campaigns, we build the platform capabilities that make booking an Airbnb accessible and seamless for everyone. By optimizing the guest checkout experience and understanding regional nuances, we directly drive the company's topline growth and market penetration.
   

  

**The Difference You Will Make** 
**Deep Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** 
 Partner closely with Product, Finance, Data, and other XFN stakeholders to define market\-level technical strategies and deliver high\-impact features.
   

  

* 
+ Drive Topline Growth: Take end\-to\-end ownership of engineering projects that directly impact the company’s Gross Booking Value (GBV) and growth by optimizing regional checkout conversion funnels.
+ Elevate the Guest Checkout Experience: Architect and build solutions that offer the right payment options at the right time, minimizing friction and maximizing payment approval rates for guests around the world.
+ Unlock Affordability \& Partnerships: Design robust backend capabilities to support region\-specific partner campaigns, installment plans, and targeted discounts, making travel more affordable while accelerating business growth.
+ Architect \& Execute: Drive the technical design, architecture, and implementation of region\-first builds, balancing custom local needs with the sustainability of our global payments platform.


**A Typical Day**
* Take end\-to\-end ownership of backend services and APIs (primarily in Java), from architectural design and coding to deployment and maintenance.
* Build and integrate local payment methods, affordability features (like installments), and promotional campaign logic, tailoring our systems to diverse consumer expectations.
* Analyze input and health metrics (e.g., checkout conversion funnels, payment success rates) to turn data insights into actionable engineering improvements that drive GBV.
* Collaborate with Finance and Product to align technical execution with Airbnb’s broader business strategy, ensuring we deliver strong business efficiency and ROI on partner campaigns.
* Actively monitor product/service health, participate in on\-call rotations, and proactively identify areas to reduce tech debt and improve system reliability over time.
* Foster a collaborative and inclusive engineering culture, sharing knowledge, participating in code reviews, and occasionally mentoring peers


**Your Expertise** 
  

  

* 
+ 3 to 6 years of industry software engineering experience in big tech companies, with a proven track record of end\-to\-end ownership of projects and system architecture.
+ Proficiency in backend development, primarily in Java (our core stack), with the ability to navigate full\-stack environments or learn new languages as needed.
+ B.Tech/BE in Computer Science, MIS, or equivalent technical qualification.
+ Payments Knowledge is a Plus: Experience with payment networks, checkout funnels, promotional campaigns, or affordability products (e.g., Buy Now Pay Later, installments) is highly desired, but a strong willingness to learn is just as valuable.
+ Experience building and scaling reliable web applications, specifically focusing on optimizing user funnels, conversion rates, and driving growth metrics.
+ Strong ability to navigate ambiguity by proactively seeking guidance, distilling complex requirements, and designing scalable solutions.
+ Excellent communication skills—capable of writing detailed technical design documents and collaborating effectively with both technical and non\-technical XFN partners (e.g., Finance, Product, Marketing).


**Our Commitment To Inclusion \& Belonging**
 Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively\-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
   

  

 We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.
   

  

 We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

 We’re a unique company that gives you space to fit in and enables you to make use of your skills. Our systems are being used by over 170,000 co\-workers and serve over 4 billion customers globally!

We have values and we live them – they’re all important and I’m happy to share them with you in more detail, but these stand out for me:
   

 Togetherness, Simplicity, leading by example, and different with a meaning – get in touch and I can explain in detail!

title: Software Development Engineer 1
description:
**Company Overview**
 WEX is an innovative global commerce platform and payments technology company looking to forge the way in a rapidly changing environment, to simplify the business of doing business for customers, freeing them to spend more time, with less worry, on the things they love and care about. We are journeying to build a consistent world\-class user experience across our products and services and leverage customer\-focused innovations across all our strategic initiatives, including big data, AI, and Risk.
   

  

****Team Overview****
 Risk Platform’s agile engineering teams build the services, system integrations and analytic tools that enable WEX products and business lines to make smart risk decisions at scale as they grow. Major platform systems include credit decisioning, credit portfolio management, fraud detection, risk data analytics, compliance, and collections. Risk Platform engineers address the needs of our business partners by designing, building and deploying scalable, observable solutions utilizing modern, cloud\-based service architectures and leveraging WEX’s world\-class AI and big data platforms.
   

  

****Position Summary****
 We are looking for a highly motivated and highly potential entry level Engineer to join our Risk Engineering team to make big business impacts and grow your area.
   

  

 This is a really exciting time to be in the Risk Engineering team at WEX. Wex has sophisticated business and products empowering a wide variety of customer businesses. Data generated from these production systems, applications, and platforms are rich and complex. As one of the most valuable assets of Wex, the data provides huge potential values for our customers and business. It’s the Risk team’s responsibility to build Risk, platforms, systems, and tools to clean, process, enrich, and optimize the core company data, and make them easy and efficient to use to enable Wex customers and internal teams to generate customer and business values. We build value added data products for Wex customers too. We leverage advanced technologies from the industry to ensure our efficiency and effectiveness, including modern big data technologies and AI technologies.
   

  

 We have challenging problems with huge business impact potentials for you to work on and grow. We also have a strong team with highly talented and skillful engineers and leaders to support, guide, coach you.
   

  

 If you dream to be a strong engineer who can solve tough problems, generate big impacts, and grow fast, this is a great opportunity for you!
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with stakeholders to learn about our customers biggest challenges.
* Learn and practice design, test, code, and instrument new data products/systems/platforms at small to medium complexity level.
* Learn ways to effectively measure, inspect, and drive decisions using data.
* Learn and develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions.
* Learn and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform, including provisioning and managing cloud\-based data infrastructure.
* Practice software development with TDD and BDD, Microservice and Vertical Slice Architectures.
* Learn to support live data products/systems/platforms, promote proactive monitoring, rapid incident response, and continuous improvement.
* Learn to analyze existing systems and processes to identify bottlenecks and opportunities for improvements.
* Learn from your peers, foster continuous learning within your team and organization.
* Learn our team’s process and best practices, and apply them to given tasks with help from peers and your manager. Make sure to understand customer/business problems you try to solve with these tasks, and your design and implementation can actually solve these problems in an effective, reliable, and sustainable way.
* Partner with and assist your peers on completing tasks.
* Focus on continuous learning of new technologies.
* Proactively seek reviews from senior engineers on your work to ensure quality.
* Learn and build reliable, secure, efficient, and easy to use big data platforms and tools at scale for supporting all kinds of data transferring, ingestion, processing, serving, delivery, consumption, and data governance needs.
* Learn and build systems, platforms, data pipelines, and tools for E\-2\-E data life cycle, including data ingestion, cleaning, processing, enrichment, optimization, and serving by leveraging the Data platform. It’s our responsibility to deliver high quality, rich, easy to understand \& use data for external and internal purposes. For these, you will learn and build data quality measurement \& monitoring techniques and systems, metadata and data catalog, Master Data Management, etc.
* Learn and master common big data technologies, tools, and software packages, including proper integrations with Wex systems and proper execution in an engineering way.
* Learn data modeling techniques and use them to design/implement efficient and easy to use data models and structures.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field. OR demonstrable equivalent deep understanding, experience, and capability.
* 1\-2 years of experience in software engineering is a plus.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Capable of designing a good solution for a small/medium scale problem or component.
* Strong implementation skills using languages like Java, C\#, Golang, \& Python, including coding, automated testing, measurement and monitoring.
* Good understanding of data ingestion, cleaning, processing, enrichment, serving, quality assurance techniques and tools, such as data pipeline development, SQL \& relational algebra, DBs, ELT.
* Some knowledge of data warehousing concepts and dimensional modeling.
* Passionate about keeping up with modern technologies and design. Interested in data and data processing.
* Strong willingness and capability to learn new technology and tools quickly when needed. Passionate about keeping up with modern technologies and design. Interested in data, big data technology, cloud technology.
* Passionate about understanding and solving customer/business problems.

* Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.

title: Junior Backend Developer (TypeScript + AI)
description:
**About the role** 

 We're hiring a backend developer to own the engineering side of our B2B cold email and lead generation operation. You'll build scrapers, LLM workflows, and the systems that send personalized outreach at scale.
 



  




**Read this first** 

 Before you apply, please check if this role is actually for you. We've been getting too many wrong applications.
 



 This is
 **not** 
 a QA, SDET, or test automation role. If your work involves Selenium, Cypress, Playwright tests, TestNG, JUnit, Postman collections, or anything with "testing" in your job title, this role is not for you. The "automation" in this role means business workflow automation, like "when X happens, automatically do Y" across cold email and lead gen systems.
 



 This is
 **not** 
 a Zapier or Make.com role. You will write TypeScript every day.
 



 This is
 **not** 
 a Python or ML role. The entire codebase is TypeScript and Node.js. We use AI through API calls to OpenAI and Anthropic, we don't train models. If you're a Python developer or ML engineer, this isn't the right fit unless you have serious TypeScript experience.
 



 This is
 **not** 
 a senior role. Budget is ₹16 LPA max. If you earn more than that today, please don't apply.
 



 This is
 **not** 
 a generic backend role. We need someone who knows cold email and outbound. If you've never heard of Smartlead, Instantly, or Apollo, this isn't the role.
 



  




**What we do** 

 We run cold email campaigns for B2B clients. We find target companies, find decision makers in them, write personalized emails using AI, and send them through warmed up inboxes. All of this is code, not manual work.
 



**Stack: TypeScript, Node.js, n8n, Postgres, OpenAI, Anthropic, Apify, Playwright, plus the usual cold email tools (Smartlead, Instantly, Apollo, Clay).** 




**Note: while we use AI heavily, this is API integration work, not model training. If you're looking for an ML engineering role, this isn't a fit.** 




  




**What you'll do** 

 Build and maintain the systems that run our pipeline. Specifically:
 


* Scrapers that find target companies and pull contact details of decision makers
* LLM workflows that write personalized emails using real signals about the prospect
* A dashboard to monitor inbox placement, bounces, and domain health across clients
* Triggers that fire outreach when something interesting happens (new hire, funding, tech change)
* Eval suites that score LLM output quality so we can change prompts and models without breaking results



  




**Who you are** 

 You've worked in or around cold email before. Maybe at a lead gen agency, maybe a sales tech startup, maybe as a freelancer for outbound teams. The exact title doesn't matter. What matters is that you understand how cold email actually works and you can write code.
 



 You should know:
 


* TypeScript well enough to ship production code
* SQL and Postgres
* How to call OpenAI or Anthropic APIs and handle their quirks
* Basic scraping with Apify, Playwright, or Puppeteer
* n8n or a similar tool, used for real things, not just demos
* Cold email fundamentals: deliverability, warmup, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, bounce dynamics



 If you don't know all of these, that's fine, but you should know most of them.
   




**How hiring works** 
1. A 45 minute call with the founder
2. A paid 2 week trial in our actual repo
3. Offer based on the trial

description:

 The Employee Experience Team at MongoDB India is the face of HR to the approximately 800 employees. The team is responsible for providing full employee life cycle service delivery from onboarding to separation management in partnership with the rest of the People Team including the following CoEs: Recruiting, Total Rewards, Learning and Development, Employee Engagement \& Inclusion, HR Business Partnering and HR Operations. You will need to shift regularly between tactical and strategic priorities, deal with a lot of change and focus on driving outcomes across a wide range of levels in the company

description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.
 
  
 


**Roku is changing how the world watches TV** 

 Roku is the \#1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.
 



 From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable \- and valued \- contribution. We're a fast\-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.
 



  
 



**About the Team** 




 We are the Global Enterprise Network Engineering team at Roku, responsible for designing, deploying, and maintaining a high\-performance, secure, and resilient network that keeps our offices running and our engineers productive. We work with cutting\-edge technologies, including advanced SD\-WAN, high\-density WiFi, next\-gen firewalls, automation, and cloud networking, to ensure seamless connectivity and operational efficiency. Our team focuses on scalability, security, and performance, enabling Roku employees to innovate without network limitations.
 



 Every team member contributes to the success of the team, and every decision matters. We aim to make our products easy to use and joyful to use for our customers. Ideally, we are looking for a candidate who possesses exemplary technical skills, is passionate, pays attention to every detail, and is not afraid to take on a challenging task. In this role, employees are expected to be self\-driven, willing, and capable of taking full ownership of features and projects and leading them to successful completion.  
 



  
 



**About the role** 




 As a Sr. Network Engineer at Roku, you play a critical role in designing, implementing, and maintaining a high\-performance, secure, and scalable network infrastructure. You work with cutting\-edge technologies, including SD\-WAN, high\-density WiFi, next\-gen firewalls, automation, routing and switching, and cloud networking, to ensure seamless connectivity across all Roku offices. Your responsibilities include troubleshooting complex network issues, optimizing performance, enhancing security, and driving automation to improve operational efficiency. You collaborate with cross\-functional teams to support business needs, ensuring that Roku employees have a reliable and secure network to stay productive.
 



  
 



**What you'll be doing** 



1. **Network Design and Implementation:**


* Design, configure, and implement network solutions based on business requirements.
* Deploy, manage, and troubleshoot Cisco IOS, Cato SD\-WAN, Meraki, and Wireless 802\.11ax technologies and Infoblox.
* Ensure network security and compliance with industry standards and best practices.


1. **Network Optimization and Performance:**


* Monitor network performance and optimize it for maximum efficiency and reliability.
* Identify and resolve network issues, bottlenecks, and vulnerabilities.
* Implement network upgrades and improvements to enhance overall performance.


1. **Documentation and Reporting:**


* Maintain accurate network documentation, including network diagrams, configurations, and procedures.
* Generate reports on network performance, security, and other relevant metrics.


1. **Collaboration and Support:**


* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams and vendors to support business initiatives.
* Provide technical support and mentorship to junior staff members.



  
 



**We're excited if you have** 



* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field, MS degree preferred.
* Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) or higher certification preferred.
* Minimum 7 years proven experience in designing, implementing, automating,  and managing complex network infrastructures.
* Hands\-on experience with Cisco IOS,Network Automation, Cato SD\-WAN, Meraki, and Wireless 802\.11ax technologies.
* In\-depth knowledge of routing, switching, firewall, and VPN technologies.
* In depth knowledge when it comes to Infoblox.
* Experience with cloud\-managed networking solutions, specifically Meraki.
* Strong understanding of Wireless 802\.11ax standards and deployment best practices.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Certifications in related technologies such as Meraki or Cato SD\-WAN are a plus.
* Ability to convey complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders clearly.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and industry trends.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic work environment.



 You will possess the skills and confidence to navigate working in a fast\-paced environment and be frequently taken out of your comfort zone
 *.* 
 You will need to be able to ask questions and apply critical thinking to situations and seize opportunities to learn and improve yourself independently along with keeping up to date with the latest technologies. 
 


  
   


  
 



  
 


**Our Hybrid Work Approach** 

 Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are flexible for remote work except for employees whose roles are required to be in the office five days a week or employees who are in offices with a five day in office policy.
 



  
 


**Benefits** 

 Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Our employees can take time off work for vacation and other personal reasons to balance their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.
 



  
 


**Accommodations** 

 Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.
 



  
 


**The Roku Culture** 

 Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast\-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.
 



 We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem\-solvers, which itself is a two\-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002\.
 



 To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.
 



 By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 As a Networking Managed Services Engineer (L1\) at NTT DATA, you'll step into an entry\-level role where your primary focus will be providing managed services to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. Your day will involve proactively identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems to support our clients effectively.
   

  

 You'll monitor client infrastructure and solutions, catching errors before or as soon as they occur. Your role will involve investigating first\-line incidents, understanding their root causes, and following approved procedures for request fulfilment. Whether it's providing telephonic, ITSM ticket or chat support, executing maintenance activities like patching and configuration changes, or ensuring smooth shift handovers for continuous service, your efforts are all about maintaining high standards of service quality.
   

  

 You'll also identify opportunities for optimization, whether it's reducing common incidents or finding automation possibilities for request fulfilment, incident resolution, and process improvements. Your role may occasionally extend to supporting project work and disaster recovery functions and tests, contributing to our broader goals and ensuring we're always ahead of the curve.
   

  

 Throughout your journey with us, you'll ensure that incidents and requests are resolved efficiently and comprehensively, escalating when necessary. You'll also help update existing knowledge or to share valuable insights, ensuring we continuously learn and improve.
   

  

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**
* Basic understanding in technologies such as Pulse Secure SSL VPN, Virtual Juniper, Palo Alto, Fortinet Firewalls, Cisco Nexus switches, ASr and ISr routers, Cisco ACS, ISE, Meraki switches, and common routing protocols like BGP, OSPF, and EIGrP.
* Highly disciplined in handling of tickets on day\-to\-day basis. Act promptly as per defined Sop’s.
* Try to resolve as many tickets as possible using available Knowledge articles or provided Sop’s.
* Good understanding of using ITSM tools and ITSM processes.
* Strong planning skills, considering possible changes and circumstances.
* A strong work ethic, including the capacity to put in longer hours when necessary.
* Adaptability to changing environments.
* A client\-focused approach, creating positive client experiences throughout their journey.
* The aptitude to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.
* Excellent active listening skills, confirming understanding and seeking relevant information.
* A positive outlook and resilience under pressure.
* A bachelor’s degree in information technology/computing or equivalent experience.


**Workplace type:**
 On\-site Working
   

  

**About NTT DATA**
 NTT DATA is a $30\+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R\&D.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.
   

  

**Third parties fraudulently posing as NTT DATA recruiters**
 NTT DATA recruiters will never ask job seekers or candidates for payment or banking information during the recruitment process, for any reason. Please remain vigilant of third parties who may attempt to impersonate NTT DATA recruiters—whether in writing or by phone—in order to deceptively obtain personal data or money from you. All email communications from an NTT DATA recruiter will come from an
 **@nttdata.com** 
 email address. If you suspect any fraudulent activity, please
 *contact us* 
 .

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
 Material is a modern marketing services firm powered by sophisticated analytics, deep human
   

  

 understanding and a specialized type of creativity, design thinking. Headquartered in LA, the
   

  

 company has grown consistently for nearly 50 years to 1200\+ employees in 20 offices including
   

  

 NY, Chicago, San Francisco, Austin, and London. Material has actively acquired a portfolio of
   

  

 businesses to build a unique, integrated marketing services business with key capabilities in
   

  

 analytics, intelligence, and experience for an array of top tier clients in entertainment, tech, retail,
   

  

 healthcare, and packaged goods.
   

  

**Overview**
 Reporting to the Associate Director, Infrastructure (Network) as a member of the Infrastructure \&
   

  

 Platforms team, the Senior Network Engineer is a knowledgeable, talented and skilled IT
   

  

 professional who acts as a Subject Matter Expert in the network connectivity, security and
   

  

 operations domains across Material. The Senior Network Engineer should be ready to partner
   

  

 with any team or individual at any technical level to understand their networking needs \&
   

  

 demands, advise on best practice, and identify \& deliver fit\-for\-purpose solutions. They will
   

  

 always be ready to take the technical lead in any given situation while creating sustainability in
   

  

 their role by partnering with experts on niche or advanced topics.
   

  

 Appreciating nuance, but fighting complexity, they are motivated by the satisfaction of delivering
   

  

 faster, more reliable and more secure network solutions, and are energized by exposure to the full
   

  

 gamut of network connectivity, security \& operations concepts, from solutions requirements
   

  

 gathering \& design to implementation \& migration efforts, to operational management of delivered
   

  

 solutions.
   

  

 What does success look like?
   

  

 A successful Senior Network Engineer will have mastered the arts of:
   

  

* Network: Successfully implementing and managing an effective suite of network


 services for Material, that underpins a modern Digital Workplace with the right
   

  

 infrastructure and the right support.
   

  

* Security: Ensuring the network solutions delivered \& operated match the levels of


 confidentiality, integrity \& availability appropriate to the needs of Material,
   

  

 while contributing to \& sustaining a culture of pragmatic security best practice.
   

  

* Operations: Ensuring the right monitoring, recovery \& business\-as\-usual support


 for Material’s network solutions is delivered consistently, minimising single points of
   

  

 failure and leveraging the use of operations partners where appropriate.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of the network demands, requirements \& ways of working
   

  

 within Material, the Senior Network Engineer will have delivered solutions that “just work”
   

  

 without being noticed, built confidence and trust with their colleagues, and be armed with
   

  

 the experience \& know\-how to take on bigger responsibilities as a subject matter expert
   

  

 in any network architecture, operations management or portfolio/project management
   

  

 roles they have a passion for.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Bring insight \& know\-how to the design, implementation \& operation of Material’s network


 services, including LAN, WAN, WLAN and Security technologies.  
   

  

* Determine \& prioritize processes \& technology solutions that deliver the best outcomes


 for the network and Material's users.  
   

  

* Manage \& own the products, processes \& services that support the network’s technology,


 privacy \& security needs in an effective, customer\-centric manner.  
   

  

* Engage \& energize Material IT on their use of network technologies, helping to get the most


 “bang for our buck”, without stepping on landmines.
   

  

* Bring structure to ambiguity by proposing, implementing \& documenting “secure\-bydesign” solutions and process, while remaining flexible in, and responsive to, the changing


 needs of our business.  
   

  

**Collaboration**
* Work in a 24x5 rotating shift model. Engage \& support Material IT globally


 in defining strategies \& direction for our network services’ future state.
   

  

* Drive \& facilitate discussions between Material IT’s service owners, teams \& partners


 globally, ensuring the right people are involved at the right time on network topics.
   

  

* Partner deeply with global Material IT and Security team members to evaluate, implement


 \& run the right process \& technology solutions for our network services.
   

  

 Operations
   

  

* Fix it, when our network services do not work, taking point on troubleshooting procedures


 \& designing resolution scripts for faster recovery by our partners.  
   

  

* Establish \& monitor key performance indicators that show clearly whether the Material’s


 network services and partners are delivering, or highlighting where we need to improve.   
   

  

* Communicate engagingly with IT and Security stakeholders to ensure alignment, manage


 expectations, and demonstrate the capability \& reliability of Material network services.   
   

  

* Relentlessly drive an end user focused IT culture that delivers on our mission of People


 First, easily pivoting from “No” to “How” when faced with challenges.  
   

  

* Support Material IT teams to understand the network service landscape,


 ensuring our solutions are well understood, supported and improved upon by all teams as
   

  

 well as documented.
   

  

* Identify \& mitigate risks, by taking proactive steps to prevent undesirable


 outcomes, and striking the right balance between practical and secure solutions.
   

  

* Continuously evolve, by closely tracking network security best practices \& trends, and


 proactively making recommendations for improvement within Material.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Education \& Certifications:**
* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, or Engineering (B.E/B


 Tech/M. E/M Tech), or related field or equivalent experience.
   

  

* CCNP certified mandatory.
* Networking certification on cloud in any one AWS/Azure/GCP will be an


 advantage.
   

  

* Knowledge of SOC 2/ISO 27001 will be an advantage.


**Functional**
**Done it:**
* Implemented large network solutions at multi\-site; worked on chassis like Nexus


 5K/7K, catalyst series eg: 3850; security devices like Cisco FTD’s, FMC and ASA.
   

  

* Implemented and managed F5 APM/LTM
* Implemented high availability through VRRP/HSRP
* Site to site connectivity eg: MPLS, SD\-WAN, IPsec, client to site connectivity –


 SSL VPN’s e.g.: Cisco AnyConnect.
   

  

* Managed Security solutions like IPS/IDS, gateway antimalware, web filtering,


 content filtering etc.
   

  

* Implemented and managed NACL like Cisco ISE.
* Dynamic routing – EIGRP, OSPF, BGP etc.


**Know It**
* 8 to 10 years of experience in Network Engineering,
* CCNP Certified \- Manda
* Knowledge of related technologies including encryption
* Experience in cloud network connectivity (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* Knowledge of syslog’s, SIEM.
* Knowledge of IPAM


**Shown It**
* Demonstrable experience in converting complex business needs into fit\-forpurpose, straight forward solutions, with well\-managed execution and robust


 transition to operations.
   

  

* Implemented complex Networks \- LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPN, Proxies and Network


 security technologies.
   

  

* Demonstrable experience on WAF, Load balancers


**Do it**
* Implement and maintain new network solutions.
* Manage existing infrastructure including upgrades and refresh.
* Setup network of upcoming Material offices.
* Monitoring and disaster recovery.
* Manage and maintain load balancers
* Work in 24x5 rotating shifts providing global support.
* Engage with global IT team, stakeholders, partners, vendors for projects,


 maintenance etc.
   

  

**Competencies**
* An innovator, creative and constantly looking for ways to improve Material


 IT’s ways of working.  
   

  

* A relationship builder and team player who identifies \& promotes best practices


 to colleagues, counterparts and partners alike, ensuring the case for change
   

  

 is internalized by their peers and partners through influence \& persuasion.  
   

  

* A multi\-tasker, able to work in a fast\-paced environment without getting


 overwhelmed easily.  
   

  

* An eye for detail, always ready to put in the extra effort to deliver polished, wellformed IT solutions for Material.
* Mindful of the employee experience \- articulate, confident \& well\-spoken in all


 forms of communication, comfortable to be the voice of our customer to Material
   

  

 IT, and the face of Material IT to our customers.

title: Network Engineer (Site Reliability Engineer)
description:
**About Us**
 At ExxonMobil, our vision is to lead in energy innovations that advance modern living and a net\-zero future. As one of the world’s largest publicly traded energy and chemical companies, we are powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by the pride in what we do and what we stand for.
   

  

 The success of our Upstream, Product Solutions and Low Carbon Solutions businesses is the result of the talent, curiosity and drive of our people. They bring solutions every day to optimize our strategy in energy, chemicals, lubricants and lower\-emissions technologies.
   

  

 We invite you to bring your ideas to ExxonMobil to help create sustainable solutions that improve quality of life and meet society’s evolving needs. Learn more about
 **our What and our Why** 
 and how we can work
 **together** 
 .
   

  

**ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India**
 ExxonMobil’s affiliates have offices in India in Bengaluru, Mumbai and the National Capital Region.
   

  

 ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India supporting the Product Solutions business engage in the marketing, sales and distribution of performance as well as specialty products across chemicals and lubricants businesses. The India planning teams are also embedded with global business units for business planning and analytics.
   

  

 ExxonMobil’s LNG affiliate in India supporting the upstream business provides consultant services for other ExxonMobil upstream affiliates and conducts LNG market\-development activities.
   

  

 The Global Business Center \- Technology Center provides a range of technical and business support services for ExxonMobil’s operations around the globe.
   

  

 ExxonMobil strives to make a positive contribution to the communities where we operate, and its affiliates support a range of education, health and community\-building programs in India. Read more about our Corporate Responsibility Framework.
   

  

 To know more about ExxonMobil in India, visit ExxonMobil India and the Energy Factor India.
   

  

**What Role You Will Play In Our Team**
 The Branch System Engineer will be responsible to design, build, and maintain the internal platforms and infrastructure that support software development, deployment, engineering and operations for Branch / Edge IT infrastructure (Primarily Network, but inclusive of Compute and Storage). They are responsible for building, deploying, and maintaining our sites by providing stable, secure, and scalable platforms. The core focus of Branch Systems are automation and observability platforms that provide the foundation for Site Reliability Engineering practices.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Responsible for building and maintaining network systems for employee usage. These systems include technologies such as Network Virtualization, SD\-WAN, Local Area Networks (LANs), Wide Area Networks (WANs), intranets, and extranets.
   

  

 The role requires strong skills in designing, configuring, implementing, and supporting network infrastructure. Must stay current with the latest developments in network technologies and best practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Infrastructure Reliability: Maintain and optimize network infrastructure to ensure high availability and performance.
* Automation Development: Design, implement, and manage automation workflows for tasks such as device onboarding, configuration compliance, and auto\-remediation.
* Monitoring \& Alerting: Develop and maintain/integrate monitoring systems to detect anomalies, enforce compliance, and trigger automated responses.

* Foundational understanding of Layer 2 switching concepts such as Virtual Local Area Networks (VLANs) and Spanning Tree Protocol (STP)
* Foundational understanding of Layer 3 routing protocols such as Open Shortest Path First (OSPF), Intermediate System to Intermediate System (IS‑IS), and Border Gateway Protocol (BGP)
* Introductory knowledge of Optical networking concepts, including Dense Wavelength Division Multiplexing (DWDM) and Optical Transport Network (OTN)
* Analytical problem‑solving skills and an interest in learning structured troubleshooting approaches
* Ability to communicate clearly and work effectively within a collaborative team environment


**Nice To Haves**
* Exposure to scripting or programming concepts, such as Python, or a strong interest in learning network automation

description:
**About DocPulse**




  





 Founded in 2012, DocPulse has spent over a decade building one of the most comprehensive and robust healthcare technology platforms in the industry. What started as a vision to transform healthcare delivery has evolved into a feature\-rich solution trusted by hospitals and healthcare providers across India and the Middle East.
 



 Today, we're entering an exciting hypergrowth phase. Our proven platform is now positioned to capture significant market share among SMB and large hospitals throughout India, with strategic expansion planned for the Middle East. This isn't just growth—it's scaling what works.
 



 As we expand rapidly across nearly every department, we're actively recruiting top talent who want to be part of this exciting growth journey. Join a team where 12\+ years of domain expertise meets cutting\-edge innovation, and where your work directly impacts healthcare delivery for millions of patients.
 



  





**What You'll Do**




  





**Own critical healthcare interfaces:** 

 Design and build the frontend systems that power hospital operations, patient care workflows, and clinical decision\-making across our platform — screens that doctors, nurses, and administrators rely on every day.
 




**Build for real users:** 

 Create complex, data\-heavy UIs that handle healthcare's demanding requirements — multi\-step clinical workflows, real\-time data, and interfaces that need to be fast, reliable, and intuitive under pressure.
 




**Work independently from API contracts:**

 Leverage modern tools: Use AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery while maintaining the quality and standards critical in healthtech.
 




**Shape the product:** 

 Work closely with the technical lead and clinical teams to evolve our platform, tackle complex UI challenges, and influence frontend architecture decisions that will serve thousands of healthcare providers.

* **1–2 years of solid hands\-on experience** 
  building production\-grade frontend applications
* **Next.js / React proficiency** 
 : A strong foundation in Next.js and React — this is essential for success in this role
* **API\-driven development** 
 : Ability to build complete, functional UIs directly from API contracts — no Figma dependency
* **Complex form and workflow UI** 
 : Experience building multi\-step forms, conditional flows, validation\-heavy interfaces, and data\-heavy screens
* **Full\-stack awareness** 
 : Enough understanding of how APIs and databases work to collaborate effectively with backend developers and ask the right questions
* **Version control**

* **Engineering best practices** 
 : Well\-versed in testing, code reviews, and CI/CD principles — you care about quality, not just delivery
* **Independent thinker** 
 : Strong analytical skills with the ability to make UI decisions confidently and work with minimal hand\-holding
* **Strong communicator:** 
  Clear communication and interpersonal skills — able to flag blockers early and collaborate effectively across the team

  A genuine desire to build high\-quality software that makes a difference in healthcare.



  





**Good to have:**




  




* Experience with TypeScript
* Familiarity with data visualisation libraries — charts, dashboards, real\-time data displays

title: Data Analyst
description:
**Data Analysts**
 Morningstar is looking for
 **Data Analysts,** 
 an entry\-level opportunity to join our Data and Operations group. This role will help you gain practical experience by working with diverse datasets, including public equity filings, private market transactions, ESG taxonomies, Managed Investment Data (Funds), and reference entity data. You'll build your knowledge about investment management, grow your skills in Excel, SQL, and Power BI, and benefit from structured training to support your growth, setting you up for long\-term success.
   

  

 This position will be permanently based in our Mumbai office; therefore, preference will be given to
 **candidates residing in Mumbai.** 
 Candidates in this role may need to work in rotational shifts, including night shifts.
   

  

**How does a typical day at work look?**
* Search, collect and verify data of basic and intermediate levels of complexity
* Attend to internal/client queries and requests to ensure data captured is aligned with data methodologies and policy guidelines
* Quickly learn our research methods and process standards to ensure productivity, quality, and timeliness
* Collaborate with your team, cross\-functional, and external (if required) parties to resolve data issues.


 You also get opportunities to innovate and improve processes/tools or participate in stretch projects and/or tasks besides your core responsibilities.
   

  

**You might be a good fit if you \-**
* Hold a Bachelor’s degree (preferably in finance) with 60% marks
* Demonstrate English communication skills (written/oral/comprehension)
* Are proficient in MS Office tools, especially Excel and Word
* Learn quickly and process with ease
* Possesses attention to detail, a proactive mindset, and natural curiosity
* Effectively prioritize tasks and perform well under tight deadlines


 The role is open to fresh graduates as well as professionals with up to 1 year of experience.
   

  

**How does it work?**
 Once you apply to this role, here is how the hiring process looks \-
   

  

* Online Assessment \- This includes sections on domain knowledge(finance), cognitive ability, English language, and a typing test.
* Candidate Information Session \- For those who clear the assessment, a session will be conducted to give an overview of Morningstar, our business areas, and what you can expect after joining.
* Interviews \- Shortlisted candidates will go through two rounds of interviews. This is also your opportunity to ask any questions and learn more from our interviewers.


 Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted by the Morningstar recruitment team.
   

  

**Work Location** 
 : Vashi, Navi Mumbai.
   

  

**Anticipated Joining** 
 : Q2 \- 26
   

  

**Shift Timings \-**
* Early Morning Shift (AU): 5:30 AM to 2:30 PM
* General Shift: 10 AM to 7 PM
* Afternoon Shift (UK): 3 PM to 12 AM
* Night Shift (US): 8 PM to 5 AM


**What You Can Expect From Us?**
 Find your passion through development, not just a job. As an Early Career hire, you will receive development through hands\-on experience, stretch projects, mentoring, and career development workshops.
   

  

 Meaning, belonging, and flexibility \- At Morningstar, we want you to bring your whole self to work. Individual flexibility and the ability to make choices that support work\-life integration are central to our culture and operational practices.
   

  

 Work Schedule \& Shifts \- At Morningstar, we foster a strong in\-office culture because we believe collaboration and innovation thrive when we are together. Our current Workplace Flexibility Policy allows employees to work remotely up to two days per week, providing a balance between flexibility and in\-person engagement. Given that most business units operate in rotational shifts, you are required to demonstrate flexibility in working across different shifts. Shift allowances will be provided as a recognition of your adaptability and commitment.
   

  

 At Morningstar, your talents are recognized because people are our most important assets. Across our offices worldwide, we've invested in fostering a community where your voice is heard, your ideas matter, and your contributions are rewarded.
   

  

**About Morningstar**
 Morningstar is a global leader in independent investment research, supporting investors in over 32 countries with $300\+ billion assets under management. Our mission is to empower investor success through data, research, and technology.
   

  

 We build products and offer services that connect people to the investing information and the tools that they need. We are built on the principles of independence, transparency, and long\-term thinking. By empowering investor success, we are constantly looking for new ways to help people achieve financial security.
   

  

*Morningstar is an equal\-opportunity employer.*
 Morningstar's hybrid work environment gives you the opportunity to collaborate in\-person each week as we've found that we're at our best when we're purposely together on a regular basis. In most of our locations, our hybrid work model is four days in\-office each week. A range of other benefits are also available to enhance flexibility as needs change. No matter where you are, you'll have tools and resources to engage meaningfully with your global colleagues.

title: HR Intern
description:
**Job Title:** 
 HR Intern / Executive Assistant to Founder's Office (Full\-time \| On\-site)
   

  

**Experience:** 
 0\-1 Years (Freshers with high energy are welcome)
   

  

**Company:** 
 Marketing Mojito
   

  

**About Marketing Mojito:** 
 Marketing Mojito is a full\-stack digital marketing agency built for business transformation. Here, you won't be "just an employee." You'll build brands from scratch, run end\-to\-end campaigns, and watch your ideas go live. With our learning\-first culture, you'll pick up the skills that matter, strategy, performance, content, design and analytics, while owning real outcomes. Come for the challenge; stay for the growth.
   

  

**The Vibe:** 
 Marketing Mojito is a high\-energy zone. We don't do "slow corporate HR" or boring back\-office admin. We are looking for a
 **People Person \& Operator** 
 who can spot talent from a mile away and keep the agency's heartbeat strong. You will be the bridge between the Founders and the team, ensuring that we hire the best, work efficiently, and actually enjoy the process.
   

  

**The Mission:** 
 You won't just "file papers" here. You will be the gatekeeper of our culture and the right hand to the leadership. Your mission is to build the team (Recruitment), keep the team happy (Culture), and help the Founders focus on growth by handling the operational chaos.
   

  

**What You'll Actually Do**
* The Talent Scout: You are the first filter. You will screen CVs, cold\-call candidates to assess their "vibe" and communication skills, and arrange interviews with the leadership.
* Pipeline Builder: You won't just wait for applications. You will actively tie up with institutes and colleges to build a steady pipeline of interns and freshers.
* Founder's Office Ops: You will handle miscellaneous, high\-priority tasks from the Founders' office. This requires research, coordination, and the ability to get things done without a manual.
* Chief Fun Officer: You own the vibe. You will organize office parties, birthdays, and team\-building events. If the office is quiet, it's your job to fix it.
* The Watchtower: You will keep an eye on team performance, daily attendance, and discipline to ensure the agency runs like a well\-oiled machine.


**You Bring**
* 0\-1 Year of Experience / High\-Potential Fresher: You might be new, but you are hungry to learn how a business is built.
* The Gift of Gab: You are not afraid to pick up the phone and talk to anyone—from a nervous intern candidate to a college placement officer.
* Organizational Ninja: You can manage the Founders' calendars, interview schedules, and office spreadsheets without losing track.
* High EQ: You understand people. You know how to be firm regarding attendance/performance but fun regarding culture/parties.


**Why Marketing Mojito?**
* Direct Mentorship: You work directly with the Founders/CEO. You will learn the secrets of running a business.
* Real Impact: You aren't a cog in the wheel. The people you hire will shape the future of the agency.
* Culture: We value output over hours. We work hard in Chembur, but we celebrate wins properly.

title: Senior Change Manager - ISC & MEA OU
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.  

  

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.  

  

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.

**About the role**


The Senior Change Manager is crucial in shaping how people experience and contribute to change across Haleon. The role enables, coordinates and executes our strategic programmes, owning the local change strategy and roadmap within an assigned Operating Unit or Function to ensure a coherent change experience.


The role will focus on the people side of change \- identifying, preparing, and equipping our colleagues to adopt changes in ways of working, roles, operating models, business processes, systems, technology, culture and more. It will report into the Change Management CoE Director (Centre of Excellence) and support a collaborative effort to drive change excellence at scale. This role involves significant stakeholder engagement and strategic change partnering to coordinate activities and act as a bridge between programmes and local teams on change. It will require close collaboration across a variety of stakeholders to scope, understand, localize and implement changes and cultivate a local change network.


This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced individual to join a leading global organization with an exciting transformation agenda. We are seeking individuals with demonstrable experience and passion for designing and executing strategic change locally, as well as contributing to developing Haleon’s broader transformation capability.

**Key responsibilities**

**Change Strategy \& Planning**

* Drive the execution of strategic transformation initiatives landing in assigned Operating Unit or Function by developing a change strategy and actionable roadmap.
* Understand changes impacting the assigned Operating Unit or Function by conducting change diagnostics (e.g., impact assessments) and identifying targeted change interventions.
* Ensure alignment to Haleon’s culture strategy throughout change planning and execution, embedding behavioural shifts for true adoption.

**Change Execution \& Adoption**

* Proactively support the delivery and adoption of change, including facilitating workshops, defining success metrics, assessing change effectiveness, measuring adoption and coordinating local knowledge management plans.
* Partner with Programmes to develop local business readiness criteria ahead of going\-live with change initiatives.
* Hold programme and business leads to account for leader\-led change execution.

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Communication**

* Anticipate stakeholder needs and potential areas of resistance to drive change outcomes, proactively identifying targeted mitigations.
* Coordinate change activities across relevant stakeholders and teams (HR, Communications, Programmes, Capability Leads, L\&D, etc.), acting as a bridge between Programmes and local teams
* Develop and oversee the implementation of local communications and engagement plans, including mapping key stakeholders, agreeing the engagement approach with business leaders and HR, and tailoring programme change narratives for local needs.

**Change Capability Building**

* Build a holistic change capability strategy and plan for assigned Operating Unit or Function, ensuring alignment to the enterprise skills framework.
* Develop and execute the change learning plan and curriculum with subject matter experts, partnering with Programme leads, Capability Leads, and HR to identify training needs and ensure appropriate training plans are in place, including measuring effectiveness.
* Coach and upskill business leaders on change management, holding them to account for role modelling change and culture and driving uptake in their Operating Unit or Function.
* Contribute to continuous improvement and knowledge sharing through the change management community of practice.

**Change Measurement, Risk \& Benefits Management**

* Review and report on change outcomes and benefits, grounded in metrics, with clear return on investment and linked to business outcomes.
* Identify, document and support the mitigation of key change management risks within the assigned Operating Unit or Function, working effectively across workstreams to implement interventions and resolve issues.

 **Qualifications and Skills:**

* Proven track record of executing change programmes within complex, matrixed environments, demonstrating ability to operate effectively across diverse, global teams.
* Proficiency with portfolio\-level change management including prioritization, sequencing and operating across interdependent transformations.
* Ability to translate an enterprise\-level change strategy and roadmap into an executable and measurable change and adoption plan for local deployment.
* Strong understanding of change management best practice, including tools, techniques and their practical implementation.
* Ability to effectively influence and navigate across a broad ecosystem of business stakeholders including Leaders and Line Managers, as well as fellow capability areas e.g. HRBPs, L\&D, responsible for collectively delivering change.
* Strong communication and relationship\-building skills, with the ability to simplify complex messages on change and present to business leaders.
* Strong problem solving and planning skills, with the ability to work through ambiguity and adapt the delivery approach in a changing environment.

**Preferred**

* PROSCI and/or APMG Change Practitioner certification preferred but not essential.
* Strong business acumen and understanding of business operations and operating model components, including structure, governance, processes and ways of working and ability to frame the change strategy within wider business objectives.
* Demonstrated ability to coach sponsors, cultivate change and culture champions and drive business accountability for change.
* Solid understanding of how people experience change and the drivers of change, with experience of embedding mindset and culture shifts across teams to sustain organizational and behavioral change.
* Strong data fluency with the ability to leverage analytics and insights to drive adoption, and proficiency with change management, collaboration, and digital adoption tools.

  

**Job Posting End Date**

  


2026\-05\-24**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------


Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  

  

During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  

  

The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
----------------------------------------


If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

**Note to candidates**
----------------------


The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.
